  TARGET: Freenove FNK0114S 4.0-inch ESP32 ST7796 + resistive touch

  v1.31 (APPROVED UI / FOOD-SAFETY REFERENCE UPDATE):
    - CREATE: large side-by-side COOK/RECIPE selection, recipe wraps, bigger
      c1/c2 times and hidden START line (start time retained internally).
    - Guided VENUE -> TYPE -> RECIPE selection; auto-skip a single TYPE,

    - Cancelled alarms stay persisted but are hidden from View Alarms.
    - Working Break Log OTA, pins, alarm chirps, time calculations,
      physical SELECT and data/config fetching remain unchanged.

  v1.30 (ALARM DUE FIVE-CHIRP PATTERN):
    - Each active ALARM DUE: five 60 ms chirps, four 30 ms pauses,
      followed by 2,000 ms silence; repeat until alarm marked DONE.
    - Buzzer, onboard red LED, external red LED and alert border remain
      synchronized. Normal/YES/NO button acknowledgements are unchanged.
    - Proven Break Log OTA, GPIO, storage and all other UI are unchanged.

  v1.29 (VIEW ALARMS NAVIGATION / ALARM CONFIRMATION LAYOUT):
    - View Alarms PREV/NEXT are visually grey and inactive when no alarm
      exists in that direction; disabled taps change no selection or page.
    - Mark DONE recipe name uses Sevka Fixed Bold 16 on one line inside
      the approved centered recipe panel; alarm info stays large.
    - Save Edit and Cancel Alarm confirmations reuse the same panel,
      alarm information and recipe template with their own question.
      Existing YES/NO and physical SELECT action/feedback are preserved.
    - Break Log-based OTA, GPIO and storage functions are unchanged.

  v1.28 (ALARM CHIRPS / ADVANCED COLOR / SETTINGS HOME / PHYSICAL YES):
    - ALARM DUE pulses 60ms ON / 20ms OFF; three chirps repeated twice,
      continuously looping. Screen border and both red LEDs track buzzer.
    - Advanced Settings CALIBRATE SCREEN button is green.
    - Main Settings now has HOME navigation at bottom; RSSI moves into
      the title line to avoid overlap.
    - Physical SELECT on any YES/NO confirmation performs the same YES
      action and double acknowledgment as touchscreen YES, once per press.
      Existing due-alarm physical-button immediate DONE stays unchanged.
    - Break Log-based GitHub OTA implementation remains untouched.
    - Apps Script v1.28 inserts new startup logs in Row 2 under header.

  v1.27 (CONFIRMATION / RECIPE REFERENCE):
    - Mark Alarm DONE: remove large question mark and generic CONFIRMATION
      heading; show larger alarm information and recipe name; unchanged NO/YES
      positions and alarm action semantics.
    - Confirmation NO uses the regular 20ms single synchronized buzzer/LED
      acknowledgment; YES retains the existing 60/20/60ms double pulse.
    - View Recipes: six selectable, alphabetically sorted one-line cards per

    - Preserve the working Break Log OTA, known-working GPIO assignments,
      alarm storage, existing picker and Google Sheets code unchanged.

  v1.26 (HARDWARE GPIO / RECIPE ALIGNMENT / CONFIRMATION UX):
    - Move onboard red LED to GPIO22 (active LOW); hold GPIO4 audio amp

  v1.22 (FULL UI ALIGNMENT / OTA TEST BUILD):

  v1.20 (PREVIOUS PUBLIC OTA RELEASE CANDIDATE):

  v1.19 (PREVIOUS PUBLIC OTA RELEASE CANDIDATE):

  v1.18 (PRIOR PUBLIC OTA RELEASE CANDIDATE):
    - Adds Config.DeviceMode: Test bypasses store closing and pre-opening,

    - Saves DeviceMode to NVS, safely clears a previously saved closed state

    - Backward-compatible with earlier LittleFS cache files, but they do not

  v1.17 (PRIOR PUBLIC OTA RELEASE CANDIDATE):
    - Adds a self-contained ~16px bold fixed-width GFX bitmap font,
      generated from Sevka Fixed (an Iosevka-derived OFL family).
      This is not the official upstream Iosevka Fixed font binary.
    - Uses this typeface for main buttons, alarm cards, cook names,
      recipe names, Venue and Type, and Calibrate / Screen label.
    - VIEW RECIPES: Venue and Type now use bold high-contrast 16px-style
      glyphs instead of tiny built-in 8px characters. Four recipe rows
      remain per page, with spacing adjusted to avoid overlap.
    - Retains v1.16 store-close/restart scheduling, C1/C2 behavior,
      firmware OTA check, Sheets inactivity timeout and RSSI display.

  v1.16 (PRIOR PUBLIC OTA RELEASE CANDIDATE):
    - SETTINGS: RSSI footer uses 3x (24px) bold bitmap characters;
      Calibrate / Screen is centered as two large 2x lines.
    - C1 DONE no longer asks whether to cancel linked C2: C2 stays pending.
    - Google Sheet InActivityInSeconds remains the only navigation timeout
      setting, loaded from the locally cached config (5s fallback).
    - Store close/open timetable from cached Sheet Config, checked every 60s.
      At close, purge ALL alarms in RAM and NVS, blank LCD backlight and
      flash the external GPIO27 LED for 10ms every 10s (no buzzer).
    - Three hours before Store Open, restart once per calendar day and
      run OTA-first startup. After boot, LCD ON / HOME ready for early cooks.
    - Close-state and restart-day are persisted to prevent restart loops;
      power loss and an OTA reboot during closed hours preserve darkness.
    - Offline clock fallback will NOT perform timed deletion or restart.
      A verified clock and valid cached times are required.
    - The LCD controller is still powered during closed hours; GPIO21
      switches its backlight off. No deep sleep is used.

  v1.15 (PRIOR PUBLIC OTA RELEASE CANDIDATE):
    - Adds Settings 2x3 grid (View Roster / View Recipes / red Calibrate /
      three inactive buttons) and keeps startup RSSI at bottom.
    - The right-hand header now shows v1.15 rather than startup RSSI.
    - Enlarges roster full names; adds 4-per-page read-only active
      recipe reference with Venue and Type sorted by name.
    - View Alarms initially begins at the earliest pending alarm, and
      PREV/NEXT traverse a single ascending chronological alarm list.
    - REMOVES private home Wi-Fi and Sheets token bootstrap strings.
      Those MUST already have been saved to ESP32 NVS by the earlier
      v1.14 USB firmware. DO NOT erase NVS when installing by OTA.
    - Retains existing local alarms, calibration, LittleFS roster/cache,
      GitHub OTA-first startup, and startup diagnostic reports.
    - Source and compiled release may be uploaded to the public repo,
      provided you have not manually added secrets before compilation.

  v1.12 (HISTORICAL PRIVATE USB PROVISIONING BUILD):
    - Imported home credentials from the Break Log system into NVS.
    - Not suitable for public GitHub releases; unlike this v1.16 build,
      it contained private bootstrap values in the compiled firmware.

  v1.11: Break Log HTTP reliability and fixed Google Apps Script endpoint:
    - Hardcoded Cool Temp Alarms web-app URL (no API= provisioning).
    - Break Log-style HTTPS GET, Google redirect following and one retry.
    - 20-second HTTP connection/read timeouts and sanitized diagnostics.
    - Validate flag/data/ack responses; do not treat a missing flag as No.
    - Preserve Yes-only Cook/active Recipe download and atomic local cache.
    - Private Apps Script API key remains in NVS; home Wi-Fi is seeded from
      Break Log only in the private v1.12 USB bootstrap build.

  v1.14: Break Log-style persistent startup diagnostics and independent Google Log upload.
  v1.10: Google Sheets conditional data sync + Wi-Fi setup diagnostics:
    - Reuse v1.09 flicker-free CYD display and proven OTA-first startup.
    - Cache cooks/recipes/config in LittleFS; NO sample roster/recipe records.
    - Check ONLY the remote Config.UpdateDataNow flag at startup.
    - If Yes: download config + Role=Cook roster + InUse=Yes recipes;
      validate/save ALL locally before acknowledging flag back to No.
    - If No: load saved local data; do NOT download roster/recipes/config.
    - If flag/data request fails: leave local data and remote flag unchanged.
    - Home Wi-Fi SSID/password and separate Apps Script URL/API key are
      provisioned in private ESP32 NVS via Serial Monitor, not built into
      publicly released firmware binaries. RSSI saved once at startup.
    - Wi-Fi and Bluetooth are switched OFF once startup finishes.
    - Requires separate Apps Script deployment (companion script supplied).

  v1.09: Approved Changes #1-#3:
    #1 SETTINGS shows firmware version at bottom; removes maintenance caption.
    #2 VIEW ALARMS uses 1-line bold cards with status via background:
       red=next pending, yellow=other pending, green=done;
       cancelled=neutral grey. Teal selected outline retained.
    #3 Reuses Break Monitor Wi-Fi / firmware.json / HTTPS HTTPUpdate logic.
       Connect work first, home fallback, save RSSI once, check OTA
       IMMEDIATELY, then NTP, then disable Wi-Fi AND Bluetooth.
       Local alarms are saved/restored in Preferences (v1.09 format).
       Screen and touch drivers retain proven flicker-free v1.08 logic.
       Clock uses NTP when verified. Until time is verified, the demo
       clock is shown with an explicit warning and real due triggers held.

  v1.08: Builds on last known working v1.06 and replaces only rendering
         with a 4-bit off-screen framebuffer: draw screen before sending it
         to the LCD. VIEW ALARMS selection redraws ONLY changed cards and
         action buttons; header avoids erase-and-redraw flashes. Keeps the
         ILI9341/XPT2046 setup and saved touch calibration of v1.06.
         Adds explicit forward declarations to prevent Arduino sketch
         auto-prototypes from referring to custom types too early.
  v1.07: Experimental off-screen framebuffer. All screens draw into a 38.4 KB indexed
         framebuffer before a single display transfer. No clear-screen
         flash on transitions. VIEW ALARMS stylus selection transfers only
         the old/new cards and three action buttons. Clock transfers only
         the fixed header; ALARM DUE animates only the 12 px border,
         synchronously with optional LED and buzzer. No new libraries.
  v1.06: HOME Create Alarm button now uses readable 2x font without
         changing button size; VIEW ALARMS is four individually bordered
         31px-tall cards, with a teal selected border and larger,
         legible FreeSans fonts for both lines. Touch cards match their
         visual hit areas, keeping 4/page and all other controls stable.
  v1.05: Create Alarm opens immediately from HOME with COOK/RECIPE = "-";
         COOK opens View Roster and returns to Create on stylus selection;
         RECIPE opens Choose Recipe with dependent Venue -> Type -> Recipe
         selectors. Test catalog contains exactly three user-supplied recipes.
         Green SELECT and red CANCEL; Create disabled until complete.
  v1.04: Add HOME->SETTINGS->ROSTER / CALIBRATE SCREEN; staged four-target
         stylus calibration with accuracy verification, SAVE/RETRY and a
         physical-SELECT long-press abort; 2x alarm-list text for readability;
         touch diagnostics and fixed button regions; prevent HOME repaints.
  v1.03: Improve stylus tap detection using median samples at release;
         log which HOME button was hit; remove 1-second full header
         repaint so seconds update without flashing the date/time/RSSI.
  v1.02: Fix ESP32 core PENDING name collision and Arduino auto-prototypes.

  THIS IS A NAVIGATION / STARTUP DEMONSTRATION, NOT PRODUCTION FIRMWARE.
  Roster/recipes are loaded from local cache only when present; an Apps
  Script endpoint is required before new sheet data can be downloaded.
  Alarm records now persist in ESP32 Preferences; that does NOT make this
  prototype a validated food-safety system. Offline power-on without NTP
  has NO verified time, so automatic due alarms are held (demo clock only).
  Apps Script API key MUST be provisioned before data sync works.

  LIBRARIES (Arduino Library Manager):
    Adafruit GFX Library; Adafruit ILI9341; XPT2046_Touchscreen;
    ArduinoJson (compatible v6/v7); Adafruit BusIO dependency.
    LittleFS from ESP32 core, and an OTA-capable flash partition.
    WiFi/HTTPClient/HTTPUpdate/WiFiClientSecure are in ESP32 core.
  BOARD: ESP32 Dev Module (Espressif Systems esp32 board package).

  WHAT TO TRY:
    - HOME's 4 equal-size buttons, including approved colors.
    - HOME Settings (yellow): View Roster / View Recipes / red Calibrate,
      plus three inactive reserved buttons.
    - Settings -> Calibrate Screen -> red NO / green YES -> 4 targets
      -> test alignment -> RETRY or SAVE. Prior values kept until SAVE.
    - If GPIO18 SELECT is installed, hold during power-on for calibration;
      hold 2+ seconds during calibration to cancel safely.
    - VIEW ALARMS: 4/page, separate one-line status-color cards;
      PREV/NEXT = earlier/later alarms, chronological (ascending);
      stylus selects row; no written status label.
    - VIEW ROSTER: 2 columns x 4 rows, cached Cook records only;
      initials and full names are bold and readable.
    - VIEW RECIPES: cached active Item, Venue and Type; sorted A-Z,
      4/page; BACK returns to Settings. No Wi-Fi calls.
    - HOME Create Alarm -> CREATE directly (COOK: -, RECIPE: -).
      Tap COOK -> VIEW ROSTER -> select cook -> CREATE with cook filled.
      Tap RECIPE -> CHOOSE RECIPE (Venue / Type / Recipe filtering).
      Tap a field to choose an option; SELECT commits, CANCEL discards.
      CREATE needs both cook and recipe, then confirmation -> HOME.
      c1 = Start +2hr; c2 = c1 +4hr (Start +6hr).
      Start time is captured when CREATE screen first opens.
    - EDIT: tap COOK, TIME, RECIPE, STATUS, then SAVE/DISCARD.
    - Every confirmation uses RED NO and GREEN YES.
    - Inactivity backs up one screen after cached InActivityInSeconds.
    - Tap the LARGE alarm text on HOME to TRIGGER a test ALARM DUE.
    - ALARM DUE is triggered automatically only with verified NTP time;
      offline demo clock is NOT used to trigger food-safety alarms.
    - ALARM DUE AlarmStatus::Done does NOT request confirmation; 12-pixel border
      only BELOW header blinks with external LED / buzzer / speaker.
    - For C1 DONE, C2 remains pending without any additional prompt.
    - Open Serial Monitor at 115200 to see HOME HIT button diagnostics.
    - If HOME HIT shows the WRONG button, send 'c' to recalibrate touch.

  CLOCK: NTP-based Vancouver local time after successful sync. If NTP
  cannot be confirmed, a clearly-labelled demo clock is shown and
  automatic due alarms wait for verified time. Startup RSSI is STATIC.
  Alarm times show 12-hour clock without AM/PM, as requested.
  Version number is displayed in the status header; saved RSSI in Settings.

  OPTIONAL HARDWARE ON THE EXPANSION CONNECTOR (VERIFY YOUR BOARD):
    SELECT pushbutton GPIO18 -> GND (INPUT_PULLUP)
    External LED  GPIO27 -> series resistor -> LED -> GND
    Active-LOW buzzer module IO GPIO23 (use compatible 3.3V logic).
  External LED on GPIO27 is enabled for closed-mode heartbeat; other
  optional outputs remain OFF unless explicitly enabled.
  For the board speaker socket, set ENABLE_PASSIVE_SPEAKER true only
  if the passive speaker is installed and the E32R28T pins match.

  DISPLAY NOTES: The framebuffer is a 4-bit palette (320*240/2=38,400
  bytes), not a 153,600-byte RGB565 canvas. This fits ESP32 internal RAM
  and works without PSRAM. The entire display is NEVER blanked between
  redraw passes; all pixels are prepared off-screen. Partial transfers
  use one SPI transaction and a 320-pixel RGB565 scanline buffer.

  WARNING: GPIOs, touch pinout, and speaker enable differ between CYD
  revisions. This sketch reuses the pins from your existing v1.00 sketch.
*/

// CHANGE #2: mirror the EXISTING Serial Monitor output to the startup LCD.
// The wrapper forwards all serial bytes unchanged. It does not modify any
// Wi-Fi, NTP, HTTPS, Google Sheets, storage, OTA or alarm operations.
static bool bootLogInitBuffers();
static void bootLogCapture(const uint8_t *bytes, size_t count);
static void bootLogShow(bool force=false);
static void bootLogScreenInit();
static void bootLogScreenStop();

class StartupSerialMirror : public Print {
public:
  explicit StartupSerialMirror(HardwareSerial& target): port(target) {}
  void begin(unsigned long baud) {port.begin(baud);}
  int available() {return port.available();}
  int read() {return port.read();}
  void flush() override {port.flush();}
  size_t write(uint8_t b) override {
    const size_t sent=port.write(b);
    if(mirroring && sent)bootLogCapture(&b,1);
    return sent;
  }
  size_t write(const uint8_t* data,size_t count) override {
    const size_t sent=port.write(data,count);
    if(mirroring && sent)bootLogCapture(data,sent);
    return sent;
  }
  using Print::write;
  bool mirroring=true;
private:
  HardwareSerial& port;
};
// The reference here is bound BEFORE Serial is redirected, preventing recursion.
static StartupSerialMirror startupSerial(Serial);
#define Serial startupSerial

// Previous Roti Alarm wiring: select GPIO32 to GND, buzzer GPIO18 (+),

// Do not drive original ELEGOO GPIO4/21/22/23/27 as audio/LED outputs.

              EXT_LED_PIN != SELECT_PIN && EXT_BUZZER_PIN != SELECT_PIN,

// The original raster-only font and drawing helper declarations were
// removed. Native LVGL screen builders use ntext()/nbutton().
// FIRST top-level function definition in this sketch. Keeping this after
// AlarmStatus / Screen / Rect and forward-declared Alarm allows Arduino IDE's
// autogenerated prototypes to resolve all user-defined types correctly.
static void* allocateAppMemory(size_t bytes) {
  void *p = nullptr;
  if(psramFound())p=heap_caps_malloc(bytes,MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM | MALLOC_CAP_8BIT);
  if(!p)p=heap_caps_malloc(bytes,MALLOC_CAP_8BIT);
  return p;
}

static bool contains(const Rect &r, int x, int y) {
  return x >= r.x && x < r.x+r.w && y >= r.y && y < r.y+r.h;
}

enum RecipeField : uint8_t {FIELD_VENUE, FIELD_TYPE, FIELD_RECIPE};

struct Alarm {
  uint32_t id;
  uint32_t pairId;
  char initials[4];
  char recipe[32];
  int whenMin;                  // minutes since local midnight (can cross day)
  int64_t dueEpoch;             // absolute due instant, needed across restarts
  uint8_t stage;               // 1 = c1, 2 = c2
  AlarmStatus status;
};
static constexpr int MAX_ALARMS = 40;
Alarm *alarms = nullptr; // heap allocated, preserving exact 40-alarm capacity
int alarmCount=0;
uint32_t nextId=1, nextPairId=1;
Alarm draft={};

// Versioned alarm snapshot shares Preferences namespace with the proven
// calibration data but uses a separate key. One atomic Preferences blob
// keeps alarm IDs, pair IDs, statuses and absolute due times across OTA.
static constexpr uint32_t ALARM_STORE_MAGIC = 0xCA19B109;
struct AlarmSnapshot {
  uint32_t magic;
  uint16_t format;
  uint16_t count;
  uint32_t nextAlarmId;
  uint32_t nextPairId;
  Alarm items[MAX_ALARMS];
  uint32_t hash;
};
// The save, load, and closed-state verification run sequentially.
// Share one scratch buffer instead of allocating three large BSS buffers.
// The serialized layout and Preferences key stay unchanged for OTA safety.
static AlarmSnapshot *sharedAlarmSnapshot = nullptr; // reusable heap scratch buffer
// Install core app allocations BEFORE display init, Wi-Fi, or cache access.
// PSRAM is OPTIONAL. Never infer its presence from the screen size.
static bool initAppStorage() {
  // Native LVGL widgets replace the 480x320 (76,864 byte) bitmap canvas.
  // The 12-line TFT flush buffer remains heap-allocated in internal RAM.
  // Larger slices reduce per-flush SPI overhead but consume 9,600 extra bytes
  // compared with Alpha 1.9.1. Avoid full-screen or double buffering here.
  const size_t drawBytes=PANEL_W*LVGL_DRAW_LINES*sizeof(lv_color_t);
  lvDrawPixels=(lv_color_t*)heap_caps_malloc(drawBytes,MALLOC_CAP_INTERNAL | MALLOC_CAP_8BIT);
  cooks=(Cook*)allocateAppMemory(MAX_COOKS*sizeof(Cook));
  recipes=(RecipeInfo*)allocateAppMemory(MAX_RECIPES*sizeof(RecipeInfo));
  alarms=(Alarm*)allocateAppMemory(MAX_ALARMS*sizeof(Alarm));
  sharedAlarmSnapshot=(AlarmSnapshot*)allocateAppMemory(sizeof(AlarmSnapshot));
  if(!lvDrawPixels || !cooks || !recipes || !alarms || !sharedAlarmSnapshot) {
    Serial.println("[RAM] FATAL: native LVGL data-buffer allocation failed");
    return false;
  }
  memset(lvDrawPixels,0,drawBytes);
  memset(cooks,0,MAX_COOKS*sizeof(Cook));
  memset(recipes,0,MAX_RECIPES*sizeof(RecipeInfo));
  memset(alarms,0,MAX_ALARMS*sizeof(Alarm));
  memset(sharedAlarmSnapshot,0,sizeof(AlarmSnapshot));
  Serial.printf("[RAM] Native LVGL: PSRAM=%s freeHeap=%u largestInternal=%u\n",
      psramFound()?"YES":"NO",(unsigned)ESP.getFreeHeap(),
      (unsigned)heap_caps_get_largest_free_block(MALLOC_CAP_INTERNAL|MALLOC_CAP_8BIT));
  return true;
}
static uint32_t alarmHash(const AlarmSnapshot& snap) {
  const uint8_t* p=(const uint8_t*)&snap;
  uint32_t h=2166136261UL;
  for(size_t i=0;i<offsetof(AlarmSnapshot,hash);i++) {
    h ^= p[i]; h *= 16777619UL;
  }
  return h;
}
static bool lastAlarmSaveSucceeded=false;
void saveLocalAlarms() {
  lastAlarmSaveSucceeded=false;
  AlarmSnapshot &snapshot = *sharedAlarmSnapshot;
  memset(&snapshot,0,sizeof(snapshot));
  snapshot.magic=ALARM_STORE_MAGIC;
  snapshot.format=1;
  snapshot.count=alarmCount;
  snapshot.nextAlarmId=nextId;
  snapshot.nextPairId=nextPairId;
  memcpy(snapshot.items,alarms,(MAX_ALARMS*sizeof(Alarm)));
  snapshot.hash=alarmHash(snapshot);
  size_t bytes=prefs.putBytes("alarms_v109",&snapshot,sizeof(snapshot));
  lastAlarmSaveSucceeded=(bytes==sizeof(snapshot));
  if(!lastAlarmSaveSucceeded)Serial.println("WARNING: Alarm snapshot save FAILED");
}
bool loadLocalAlarms() {
  AlarmSnapshot &snapshot = *sharedAlarmSnapshot;
  if(prefs.getBytesLength("alarms_v109")!=sizeof(snapshot))return false;
  if(prefs.getBytes("alarms_v109",&snapshot,sizeof(snapshot))!=sizeof(snapshot))return false;
  if(snapshot.magic!=ALARM_STORE_MAGIC || snapshot.format!=1 ||
     snapshot.count>MAX_ALARMS || snapshot.hash!=alarmHash(snapshot))return false;
  alarmCount=snapshot.count;
  memcpy(alarms,snapshot.items,(MAX_ALARMS*sizeof(Alarm)));
  nextId=snapshot.nextAlarmId;
  nextPairId=snapshot.nextPairId;
  if(nextId==0)nextId=1;
  if(nextPairId==0)nextPairId=1;
  return true;
}

// NTP-synchronized system time continues to run after the radio is off.
// Without a verified clock we retain demo graphics but HOLD timed alarms.
uint32_t bootMs=0;
static constexpr int DEMO_START_SECONDS = 6*3600+32*60;
int nowSeconds() {
  if(timeSynced) {
    time_t epoch=time(nullptr);
    struct tm localTime={};
    if(localtime_r(&epoch,&localTime))
      return localTime.tm_hour*3600 + localTime.tm_min*60 + localTime.tm_sec;
  }
  return DEMO_START_SECONDS + (int)((millis()-bootMs)/1000UL);
}
int nowMinutes() {return nowSeconds()/60;}
String clockHHMM(int minute) {
  int m=((minute%1440)+1440)%1440;
  int hour=(m/60)%12;
  if(hour==0)hour=12;
  char b[8]; snprintf(b,sizeof(b),"%02d:%02d",hour,m%60);
  return String(b);
}
String clockHMS() {
  int sec=nowSeconds();
  int m=((sec/60)%1440+1440)%1440;
  int hour=(m/60)%12;
  if(hour==0)hour=12;
  char b[12]; snprintf(b,sizeof(b),"%02d:%02d:%02d",hour,m%60,sec%60);
  return String(b);
}
String currentHeaderDate() {
  if(timeSynced) {
    time_t epoch=time(nullptr);
    struct tm localTime={};
    if(localtime_r(&epoch,&localTime)) {
      char buf[12];
      strftime(buf,sizeof(buf),"%d-%b",&localTime);
      return String(buf);
    }
  }
  const int days=nowSeconds()/86400;
  char buf[12]; snprintf(buf,sizeof(buf),"%02d-Nov",1+days);
  return String(buf);
}
// Derive UTC epoch for a local time-of-day offset from today's local
// midnight; values >1439 and negative values preserve day rollover.
int64_t epochForLocalMinute(int minute) {
  if(!timeSynced)return 0;
  time_t now=time(nullptr);
  struct tm today={};
  if(!localtime_r(&now,&today))return 0;
  today.tm_hour=0;today.tm_min=0;today.tm_sec=0;
  const time_t midnight=mktime(&today);
  return (int64_t)midnight + (int64_t)minute*60LL;
}

void copyText(char *dst, size_t len, const char *src) {
  if(!len) return;
  strncpy(dst,src,len-1);
  dst[len-1]='\0';
}
void addAlarm(const char *initials,const char *recipe,int whenMin,uint8_t stage,
              uint32_t pairId,AlarmStatus status) {
  if(alarmCount>=MAX_ALARMS) return;
  Alarm &a=alarms[alarmCount++];
  a.id=nextId++; a.pairId=pairId;
  copyText(a.initials,sizeof(a.initials),initials);
  copyText(a.recipe,sizeof(a.recipe),recipe);
  a.whenMin=whenMin; a.dueEpoch=epochForLocalMinute(whenMin);
  a.stage=stage; a.status=status;
}
// In Production these are reminder times; never extend them beyond the
// last staffed time. Test mode preserves the full +2h/+6h schedule.
static int scheduledCoolingMinute(int startMin, int stage) {
  const int nominal=startMin+(stage==1?120:360);
  return deviceTestMode?nominal:min(nominal,LAST_COOK_ALARM_MINUTE);
}
static bool allowNewCoolingPair() {
  return deviceTestMode || nowMinutes()<=LAST_COOK_ALARM_MINUTE;
}
extern int createC1Min,createC2Min; // Defined with the CREATE UI state below.
static bool validCreateClock(int value) {
  // No new cooling schedule formula: default remains T+2h / T+6h.
  // Test permits an overnight minute; production keeps existing staffed-hour cutoff.
  return value>=0 && value<=(deviceTestMode?2879:LAST_COOK_ALARM_MINUTE);
}
static bool createTimesValid() {
  return validCreateClock(createC1Min) && validCreateClock(createC2Min) &&
         createC2Min>=createC1Min;
}
static void addPairWithSelectedTimes(const char* initials,const char* recipe) {
  if(alarmCount>MAX_ALARMS-2)return;
  const uint32_t pid=nextPairId++;
  addAlarm(initials,recipe,createC1Min,1,pid,AlarmStatus::Pending);
  addAlarm(initials,recipe,createC2Min,2,pid,AlarmStatus::Pending);
}
void addPair(const char *initials,const char *recipe,int startMin,
             AlarmStatus c1Status, AlarmStatus c2Status) {
  if(alarmCount>MAX_ALARMS-2) return;
  uint32_t pid=nextPairId++;
  addAlarm(initials,recipe,scheduledCoolingMinute(startMin,1),1,pid,c1Status);
  addAlarm(initials,recipe,scheduledCoolingMinute(startMin,2),2,pid,c2Status);
}
static int64_t alarmSortKey(const Alarm& a) {
  return a.dueEpoch!=0 ? a.dueEpoch : (int64_t)a.whenMin*60;
}

const char *statusText(AlarmStatus s) {
  if(s==AlarmStatus::Done) return "DONE";
  if(s==AlarmStatus::Cancelled) return "CANC";
  return "PEND";
}
int sorted[MAX_ALARMS];
int visibleAlarmCount=0;
int countVisibleAlarms() {
  int n=0;
  for(int i=0;i<alarmCount;i++)
    if(alarms[i].status!=AlarmStatus::Cancelled)++n;
  return n;
}
// Preserve cancelled records in NVS while excluding them from UI pages.
void sortAlarms() {
  visibleAlarmCount=0;
  for(int i=0;i<alarmCount;i++)
    if(alarms[i].status!=AlarmStatus::Cancelled) sorted[visibleAlarmCount++]=i;
  for(int i=1;i<visibleAlarmCount;i++) {
    int value=sorted[i],j=i-1;
    while(j>=0 && (alarmSortKey(alarms[sorted[j]])>alarmSortKey(alarms[value]) ||
          (alarmSortKey(alarms[sorted[j]])==alarmSortKey(alarms[value]) && alarms[sorted[j]].id>alarms[value].id))) {
      sorted[j+1]=sorted[j]; j--;
    }
    sorted[j+1]=value;
  }
}
int nextPending() {
  int idx=-1;
  for(int i=0;i<alarmCount;i++) if(alarms[i].status==AlarmStatus::Pending) {
    if(idx<0 || alarmSortKey(alarms[i])<alarmSortKey(alarms[idx])) idx=i;
  }
  return idx;
}
int nextDue() {
  // A guessed/demo clock cannot safely trigger a food-safety alarm.
  if(!timeSynced)return -1;
  const int64_t current=(int64_t)time(nullptr);
  int idx=-1;
  for(int i=0;i<alarmCount;i++) {
    if(alarms[i].status!=AlarmStatus::Pending)continue;
    if(alarms[i].dueEpoch<=0 || alarms[i].dueEpoch>current)continue;
    if(idx<0 || alarms[i].dueEpoch<alarms[idx].dueEpoch)idx=i;
  }
  return idx;
}

int linkedC2(int index) {
  if(index<0 || index>=alarmCount) return -1;
  for(int i=0;i<alarmCount;i++)
    if(alarms[i].pairId==alarms[index].pairId && alarms[i].stage==2) return i;
  return -1;
}

// ---------------------- NAVIGATION --------------------------------
Screen screen=HOME;
Screen navStack[12];
int navDepth=0;
ConfirmAction confirmAction=CA_NONE;
uint32_t lastActivity=0, lastBlink=0, lastClockDraw=0;
uint8_t alarmChirpIndex=0; // 0..4; 60ms ON each, 30ms gaps, 2000ms after chirp 5
bool alertOn=false;
int alarmFirst=0, alarmAnchor=0, alarmPageOffset=0;
int cookingGuidePage=0;
int rosterPage=0, recipePage=0, viewRecipePage=0;
int viewRecipeSelected=-1; // Original cached recipe index, not sorted-list position
int selectedAlarm=-1;
int selectedCook=-1, selectedRecipe=-1; // '-' by default on CREATE
int rosterBrowseSelected=-1;
int chosenVenue=-1, chosenType=-1, chosenRecipe=-1;
bool guidedTypeSkipped=false;
AlarmStatus detailPreviewStatus=AlarmStatus::Pending;
bool detailPreviewChanged=false;
RecipeField optionField=FIELD_VENUE;
int createStartMin=0; // captured on entering CREATE, not recalculated on confirmation
int createC1Min=0,createC2Min=0; // independently editable previews; defaults retain +2/+6h
int editTimeCandidate=0;
uint8_t editTimeStage=1;
bool editTimeFromCreate=false;
int dueAlarm=-1;
bool rosterForEdit=false, rosterForCreate=false, recipeForEdit=false;
Calibration candidateCal = {};
TS_Point calibrationPoints[4];
int calibrationStep=0;
bool calibrationVerified=false;
bool calibrationSaveFailed=false;
bool calibrationFromSettings=false;
static const int CAL_X[4] = {CAL_MARGIN,SW-CAL_MARGIN,CAL_MARGIN,SW-CAL_MARGIN};
static const int CAL_Y[4] = {CAL_MARGIN,CAL_MARGIN,SH-CAL_MARGIN,SH-CAL_MARGIN};


// ------------------ SHARED ALARM AND RECIPE HELPERS ------------------
// Retained byte-for-byte from the working v1.31.10 build.
// These functions are used by the native LVGL UI and touch routing.
static bool alarmPastDue(const Alarm &a) {
  return timeSynced && a.dueEpoch>0 && a.dueEpoch<=(int64_t)time(nullptr);
}

bool hasRecipeFor(int venue, int type) {
  for(int i=0;i<RECIPE_COUNT;i++) {
    if(venue>=0 && recipes[i].venue!=venue)continue;
    if(type>=0 && recipes[i].type!=type)continue;
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}
int optionVenueIndex(int displaySlot) {
  if(displaySlot<0)return -1;
  int visible=0;
  for(int v=0;v<VENUE_COUNT;v++)if(hasRecipeFor(v,-1)) {
    if(visible==displaySlot)return v;
    ++visible;
  }
  return -1;
}
int optionTypeIndex(int displaySlot) {
  if(displaySlot<0 || chosenVenue<0)return -1;
  int visible=0;
  for(int t=0;t<TYPE_COUNT;t++)if(hasRecipeFor(chosenVenue,t)) {
    if(visible==displaySlot)return t;
    ++visible;
  }
  return -1;
}
int recipeOptionCount() {
  int n=0;
  if(optionField==FIELD_VENUE) {
    for(int v=0;v<VENUE_COUNT;v++)if(hasRecipeFor(v,-1))++n;
  } else if(optionField==FIELD_TYPE) {
    if(chosenVenue>=0)
      for(int t=0;t<TYPE_COUNT;t++)if(hasRecipeFor(chosenVenue,t))++n;
  } else if(chosenVenue>=0 && chosenType>=0) {
    for(int i=0;i<RECIPE_COUNT;i++)
      if(recipes[i].venue==chosenVenue && recipes[i].type==chosenType)++n;
  }
  return n;
}
int optionRecipeIndex(int slot) {
  if(slot<0 || chosenVenue<0 || chosenType<0)return -1;
  // Sort the filtered indices across the entire result set, not per page.
  // Keep original recipe index for both painting and touch hit-testing.
  static int matches[MAX_RECIPES];
  int count=0;
  for(int i=0;i<RECIPE_COUNT;i++) {
    if(recipes[i].venue!=chosenVenue || recipes[i].type!=chosenType)continue;
    int j=count;
    while(j>0 && strcasecmp(recipes[matches[j-1]].name,recipes[i].name)>0) {
      matches[j]=matches[j-1];--j;
    }
    matches[j]=i;
    ++count;
  }
  return slot<count?matches[slot]:-1;
}
// A single guided screen advances Venue -> Type -> Recipe automatically.
// Previous selected IDs stay cached for green highlights when backtracking.

int selectedGuidedOption() {
  if(optionField==FIELD_VENUE)return chosenVenue;
  if(optionField==FIELD_TYPE)return chosenType;
  return chosenRecipe;
}
int guidedOptionId(int option) {
  if(optionField==FIELD_VENUE)return optionVenueIndex(option);
  if(optionField==FIELD_TYPE)return optionTypeIndex(option);
  return optionRecipeIndex(option);
}
void setGuidedRecipePageToSelected() {
  recipePage=0;
  if(chosenRecipe<0 || chosenVenue<0 || chosenType<0)return;
  const int count=recipeOptionCount();
  for(int i=0;i<count;i++)if(optionRecipeIndex(i)==chosenRecipe) {
    recipePage=i/6;break;
  }
}

static String cookFirstName(int index) {
  if(index<0 || index>=COOK_COUNT)return "";
  String first=String(cooks[index].name);
  first.trim();
  const int space=first.indexOf(' ');
  if(space>=0)first.remove(space);
  return first;
}
static void selectCookPrepare() {
  for(int i=0;i<COOK_COUNT;i++)cookSelectOrder[i]=i;
  for(int i=1;i<COOK_COUNT;i++) {
    const int current=cookSelectOrder[i];
    const String name=cookFirstName(current);
    int j=i-1;
    while(j>=0 && (strcasecmp(cookFirstName(cookSelectOrder[j]).c_str(),name.c_str())>0 ||
          (strcasecmp(cookFirstName(cookSelectOrder[j]).c_str(),name.c_str())==0 &&
           strcasecmp(cooks[cookSelectOrder[j]].name,cooks[current].name)>0))) {
      cookSelectOrder[j+1]=cookSelectOrder[j]; j--;
    }
    cookSelectOrder[j+1]=current;
  }
}
static void enterTimeEditor(uint8_t stage,bool isCreate) {
  editTimeFromCreate=isCreate;
  editTimeStage=stage;
  editTimeCandidate=isCreate?(stage==1?createC1Min:createC2Min):draft.whenMin;
  pushScreen(EDIT_TIME);
}
void openChooseRecipe(bool editing) {
  recipeForEdit=editing;
  chosenVenue=-1;chosenType=-1;chosenRecipe=-1;
  if(editing) {
    for(int i=0;i<RECIPE_COUNT;i++)if(strcmp(draft.recipe,recipes[i].name)==0) {
      chosenRecipe=i;chosenVenue=recipes[i].venue;chosenType=recipes[i].type;break;
    }
  } else if(selectedRecipe>=0 && selectedRecipe<RECIPE_COUNT) {
    chosenRecipe=selectedRecipe;
    chosenVenue=recipes[selectedRecipe].venue;
    chosenType=recipes[selectedRecipe].type;
  }
  guidedTypeSkipped=false;
  optionField=FIELD_VENUE;recipePage=0;
  pushScreen(RECIPE_OPTIONS); // no intermediate chooser screen
}
void guidedGoBack() {
  if(optionField==FIELD_RECIPE) {
    optionField=guidedTypeSkipped?FIELD_VENUE:FIELD_TYPE;
    recipePage=0;render();
  } else if(optionField==FIELD_TYPE) {
    optionField=FIELD_VENUE;recipePage=0;render();
  } else {
    goBack(); // Create/Edit; do not overwrite the saved recipe selection
  }
}
void guidedChoose(int option) {
  const int id=guidedOptionId(option);
  if(id<0)return;
  if(optionField==FIELD_VENUE) {
    if(chosenVenue!=id){chosenVenue=id;chosenType=-1;chosenRecipe=-1;}
    // Automatically choose the only available Type for this Venue.
    int single=-1,available=0;
    for(int t=0;t<TYPE_COUNT;t++)if(hasRecipeFor(chosenVenue,t)) {
      single=t;available++;
    }
    guidedTypeSkipped=(available==1);
    if(guidedTypeSkipped) {
      chosenType=single;optionField=FIELD_RECIPE;
      setGuidedRecipePageToSelected();
    } else {optionField=FIELD_TYPE;recipePage=0;}
  } else if(optionField==FIELD_TYPE) {
    if(chosenType!=id){chosenType=id;chosenRecipe=-1;}
    guidedTypeSkipped=false;
    optionField=FIELD_RECIPE;
    setGuidedRecipePageToSelected();
  } else {
    chosenRecipe=id;
    if(recipeForEdit)copyText(draft.recipe,sizeof(draft.recipe),recipes[id].name);
    else selectedRecipe=id;
    goBack(); // Immediately close workflow, back to Create/Edit.
    return;
  }
  render();
}

String confirmationQuestion() {
  switch(confirmAction) {
    case CA_CREATE: return "Create these 2 alarms?";
    case CA_SAVE_EDIT: return "Save alarm changes?";
    case CA_LIST_DONE: case CA_HOME_DONE: return "Mark alarm DONE?";
    case CA_LIST_CANCEL: return "Cancel this alarm?";
    case CA_LIST_PENDING: return "Restore alarm PENDING?";
    case CA_START_CALIBRATION: return "Start touch calibration?";
    case CA_RESTART_DEVICE: return "Restart device now?";
    case CA_CLEAR_ALL_ALARMS: return "Clear ALL saved alarms?";
    default: return "Confirm action?";
  }
}

// ---------------------- SOUND / SYNCHRONIZED RED LEDS ---------------
// Output arbiter controls Freenove GPIO25 external LED and GPIO18 buzzer.
// GPIO18 active-HIGH buzzer wiring is not yet verified; preserve timing.
// Closed-hours LED heartbeat intentionally is silent.
static bool alarmOutputOn=false;
static bool buttonAckOn=false;
void applySignalOutputs() {
  const bool ledOn=alarmOutputOn || closedHeartbeatOn;
  const bool buzzerOn=alarmOutputOn || buttonAckOn;
  if(ENABLE_EXT_LED)digitalWrite(EXT_LED_PIN,ledOn?HIGH:LOW);
  if(ENABLE_ONBOARD_RED_LED)digitalWrite(ONBOARD_RED_LED_PIN,ledOn?LOW:HIGH);
  if(ENABLE_EXT_BUZZER)digitalWrite(EXT_BUZZER_PIN,buzzerOn?(BUZZER_ACTIVE_LOW?LOW:HIGH):(BUZZER_ACTIVE_LOW?HIGH:LOW));
  if(ENABLE_PASSIVE_SPEAKER) {
#if ESP_ARDUINO_VERSION_MAJOR >= 3
    ledcWriteTone(AUDIO_OUT,buzzerOn?1700:0);
#else
    ledcWriteTone(6,buzzerOn?1700:0);
#endif
  }
}
void soundInit() {
  // No Freenove audio-amplifier GPIO is confirmed; do not drive GPIO4.
  if(ENABLE_EXT_LED){digitalWrite(EXT_LED_PIN,LOW);pinMode(EXT_LED_PIN,OUTPUT);}
  if(ENABLE_ONBOARD_RED_LED) {
    digitalWrite(ONBOARD_RED_LED_PIN,HIGH); // active LOW: start OFF
    pinMode(ONBOARD_RED_LED_PIN,OUTPUT);
  }
  if(ENABLE_EXT_BUZZER){digitalWrite(EXT_BUZZER_PIN,BUZZER_ACTIVE_LOW?HIGH:LOW);pinMode(EXT_BUZZER_PIN,OUTPUT);}
  if(ENABLE_PASSIVE_SPEAKER) {
    pinMode(AUDIO_EN,OUTPUT);
    digitalWrite(AUDIO_EN,LOW);
#if ESP_ARDUINO_VERSION_MAJOR >= 3
    ledcAttach(AUDIO_OUT,1700,8);
    ledcWriteTone(AUDIO_OUT,0);
#else
    ledcSetup(6,1700,8);
    ledcAttachPin(AUDIO_OUT,6);
    ledcWriteTone(6,0);
#endif
  }
  applySignalOutputs();
}
void outputs(bool on) {
  alarmOutputOn=on;
  applySignalOutputs();
}
// A deliberate 20ms BUZZER-ONLY pulse. LED remains reserved for due alarms,
// closed heartbeat and the separate combined startup hardware self-test.
void acknowledgeButton() {
  buttonAckOn=true;
  applySignalOutputs();
  delay(BUTTON_ACK_MS);
  buttonAckOn=false;
  applySignalOutputs();
}
// YES/CREATE uses a double BUZZER-ONLY 60/20/60ms acknowledgement.
// NO uses one normal buzzer-only 20ms pulse.
void acknowledgeConfirmation() {
  buttonAckOn=true;
  applySignalOutputs();
  delay(60);
  buttonAckOn=false;
  applySignalOutputs();
  delay(20);
  buttonAckOn=true;
  applySignalOutputs();
  delay(60);
  buttonAckOn=false;
  applySignalOutputs();
}
void setAlert(bool on) {
  if(alertOn==on) return;
  alertOn=on;
  if(screen==ALARM_DUE) {
    nativeUpdateDueBorder(on);    // native LVGL border; no framebuffer
  }
  outputs(on);                    // LED and buzzer change with border

}

// ---------------------- STARTUP HARDWARE SELF-TEST ------------------
// Verify the buzzer briefly, then pulse external LED + buzzer together.
// The LED has no separate test: it is checked with the buzzer.
// Run once each power-on/restart BEFORE Wi-Fi/OTA, preserving their logic.
void startupHardwareSelfTest() {
  // Display stays on while the serial startup log is shown.
  digitalWrite(FREENOVE_BACKLIGHT_PIN,HIGH);
  alarmOutputOn=false;
  buttonAckOn=false;
  closedHeartbeatOn=false;
  applySignalOutputs();
  // Change #1: the buzzer self-test uses the same 20 ms duration as
  // a normal button acknowledgement, instead of a sustained 500 ms tone.
  startupMessage("TESTING LED & BUZZER","BUZZER","GPIO18 - short beep");
  if(ENABLE_EXT_BUZZER)digitalWrite(EXT_BUZZER_PIN,BUZZER_ACTIVE_LOW?LOW:HIGH);
  delay(BUTTON_ACK_MS);
  if(ENABLE_EXT_BUZZER)digitalWrite(EXT_BUZZER_PIN,BUZZER_ACTIVE_LOW?HIGH:LOW);

  // The startup-only combined test continues to drive LED + buzzer together.
  // Normal button and confirmation acknowledgement stays buzzer ONLY.
  startupMessage("TESTING LED & BUZZER","LED + BUZZER","Short startup test");
  alarmOutputOn=true; applySignalOutputs();
  delay(BUTTON_ACK_MS);
  alarmOutputOn=false; applySignalOutputs();
  // Keep the startup log visible; the original store-schedule check
  // restores closed-hours behavior after startup is complete.
  digitalWrite(FREENOVE_BACKLIGHT_PIN,HIGH);
  startupLogAdd("Startup self-test: GPIO18 buzzer short beep; "
                "GPIO25 external LED + GPIO18 buzzer combined pulse. "
                "Output commands completed (physical response not sensed)");
  Serial.println("STARTUP SELF-TEST: short buzzer beep and combined LED+buzzer pulse completed");
}

// ---------------------- SCREEN TRANSITIONS -------------------------
void render() {
  nativeRender();
}
void goHome() {
  setAlert(false);
  navDepth=0;
  screen=HOME;
  lastActivity=millis();
  render();
}
void pushScreen(Screen next) {
  if(navDepth<(int)(sizeof(navStack)/sizeof(navStack[0])))navStack[navDepth++]=screen;
  setAlert(false);
  screen=next;
  lastActivity=millis();
  render();
}
void goBack() {
  setAlert(false);
  if(navDepth==0){goHome();return;}
  screen=navStack[--navDepth];
  lastActivity=millis();
  // Any unsaved draft remains isolated and will never change stored alarms.
  render();
}
void goViewAlarms() {
  setAlert(false);
  navDepth=1;navStack[0]=HOME;
  screen=VIEW_ALARMS;
  selectedAlarm=-1;
  sortAlarms();
  alarmAnchor=0;alarmPageOffset=0;
  const int next=nextPending();
  if(next>=0)for(int i=0;i<visibleAlarmCount;i++)if(sorted[i]==next) {
    alarmAnchor=(i/ALARMS_PER_PAGE)*ALARMS_PER_PAGE;break;
  }
  alarmFirst=alarmAnchor;
  lastActivity=millis();render();
}
// Preserve the current View Alarms page on edit/done/cancel changes.
void returnToAlarmList() {
  setAlert(false);
  navDepth=1;navStack[0]=HOME;screen=VIEW_ALARMS;
  alarmAnchor=alarmFirst;alarmPageOffset=0;
  if(selectedAlarm>=0 && selectedAlarm<alarmCount &&
     alarms[selectedAlarm].status==AlarmStatus::Cancelled)selectedAlarm=-1;
  lastActivity=millis();render();
}
void enterDue(int i) {
  if(i<0 || i>=alarmCount || alarms[i].status!=AlarmStatus::Pending)return;
  setAlert(false);
  navDepth=0;
  dueAlarm=i;
  screen=ALARM_DUE;
  alarmChirpIndex=0; // First chirp starts immediately on entering ALARM DUE.
  alertOn=true;
  outputs(true);
  lastBlink=millis();
  lastActivity=millis();
  render();
  Serial.printf("DEMO: DUE AlarmID=%lu PairID=%lu\n",
       (unsigned long)alarms[i].id,(unsigned long)alarms[i].pairId);
}
void afterAlarmAction(Screen fallback) {
  int i=nextDue();
  if(i>=0){enterDue(i);return;}
  if(fallback==VIEW_ALARMS)goViewAlarms();
  else goHome();
}
void ackDue() {
  if(dueAlarm<0 || dueAlarm>=alarmCount)return;
  int doneIndex=dueAlarm;
  alarms[doneIndex].status=AlarmStatus::Done;
  saveLocalAlarms();
  outputs(false); alertOn=false;
  Serial.printf("DEMO: DONE alarm %lu (NO confirmation)\n",
                (unsigned long)alarms[doneIndex].id);
  dueAlarm=-1;
  // The linked C2 is never silently cancelled when C1 is marked DONE.
  afterAlarmAction(HOME);
}
void confirm(ConfirmAction action) {
  confirmAction=action;
  pushScreen(CONFIRMATION);
}
// Clear both in-memory and NVS alarms; verify persisted empty state before
// reporting success. Never clear cook/recipe caches or touch calibration.
bool clearAllSavedAlarms() {
  outputs(false);alertOn=false;dueAlarm=-1;
  memset(alarms,0,(MAX_ALARMS*sizeof(Alarm)));
  alarmCount=0;nextId=1;nextPairId=1;
  selectedAlarm=-1;draft={};
  bool empty=(prefs.getBytesLength("alarms_v109")==0);
  if(!empty) {
    prefs.remove("alarms_v109");
    empty=(prefs.getBytesLength("alarms_v109")==0);
  }
  if(!empty) {
    saveLocalAlarms(); // Fallback: validated zero-item snapshot
    if(prefs.getBytesLength("alarms_v109")==sizeof(AlarmSnapshot)) {
      AlarmSnapshot &check=*sharedAlarmSnapshot;
      if(prefs.getBytes("alarms_v109",&check,sizeof(check))==sizeof(check))
        empty=check.magic==ALARM_STORE_MAGIC && check.format==1 &&
              check.count==0 && check.hash==alarmHash(check);
    }
  }
  Serial.println(empty?"Clear all alarms: NVS verified empty":"WARNING: Alarm erase NOT verified");
  return empty;
}
void yesConfirmation() {
  ConfirmAction action=confirmAction;
  // Universal confirmation: YES executes; NO/timeouts simply goBack().
  if(action==CA_RESTART_DEVICE) {
    // The double confirmation ACK was completed by onTap() before restart.
    Serial.println("User confirmed device restart; preserving NVS and LittleFS");
    Serial.flush();
    ESP.restart();
    return;
  } else if(action==CA_CLEAR_ALL_ALARMS) {
    if(clearAllSavedAlarms())goHome();
    else {
      goBack();
      startupMessage("CLEAR FAILED","Storage error","Do not power off");
    }
  } else if(action==CA_START_CALIBRATION) {
    startCalibration(true);
  } else if(action==CA_CREATE) {
    if(selectedCook<0 || selectedRecipe<0 || !allowNewCoolingPair()) {
      Serial.println("CREATE blocked: cook and recipe required");
      goBack();
      return;
    }
    if(alarmCount>MAX_ALARMS-2) {
      Serial.println("CREATE blocked: demo alarm array is full");
      goBack();
      return;
    }
    addPairWithSelectedTimes(cooks[selectedCook].initials,recipes[selectedRecipe].name);
    saveLocalAlarms();
    Serial.println("Pair created and saved locally");
    goHome();
  } else if(action==CA_SAVE_EDIT) {
    if(selectedAlarm>=0 && selectedAlarm<alarmCount) {
      // In Production, reject a pending edit to a time later than 10:15 PM.
      if(!deviceTestMode && draft.status==AlarmStatus::Pending &&
         (draft.whenMin<0 || draft.whenMin>LAST_COOK_ALARM_MINUTE)) {
        Serial.println("Edit time after 10:15 PM blocked in Production");
        goBack();return;
      }
      alarms[selectedAlarm]=draft;saveLocalAlarms();
    }
    returnToAlarmList();
  } else if(action==CA_LIST_CANCEL) {
    if(selectedAlarm>=0 && selectedAlarm<alarmCount) {alarms[selectedAlarm].status=AlarmStatus::Cancelled;saveLocalAlarms();}
    returnToAlarmList();
  } else if(action==CA_LIST_PENDING) {
    if(selectedAlarm>=0 && selectedAlarm<alarmCount && !alarmPastDue(alarms[selectedAlarm])) {
      alarms[selectedAlarm].status=AlarmStatus::Pending;
      saveLocalAlarms();
    }
    returnToAlarmList();
  } else if(action==CA_LIST_DONE || action==CA_HOME_DONE) {
    int i=selectedAlarm;
    if(i>=0 && i<alarmCount) {
      alarms[i].status=AlarmStatus::Done;
      saveLocalAlarms();
    }
    if(action==CA_LIST_DONE)returnToAlarmList();else goHome();
  } else goBack();
}

// Direct CREATE: do not enter the universal YES/NO confirmation screen.
// The same NVS snapshot format and existing addPair() logic are retained.
// On a failed NVS write, undo just this new pair in RAM and show an error.
static bool createSaveError=false;
static bool createPairImmediately() {
  if(selectedCook<0 || selectedCook>=COOK_COUNT ||
     selectedRecipe<0 || selectedRecipe>=RECIPE_COUNT ||
     !allowNewCoolingPair() || !createTimesValid() || alarmCount>MAX_ALARMS-2) {
    Serial.println("CREATE blocked: invalid cook, recipe, hours, or full alarm list");
    return false;
  }
  const int previousCount=alarmCount;
  const uint32_t previousId=nextId,previousPairId=nextPairId;
  addPairWithSelectedTimes(cooks[selectedCook].initials,recipes[selectedRecipe].name);
  saveLocalAlarms();
  if(!lastAlarmSaveSucceeded) {
    alarmCount=previousCount;
    nextId=previousId;
    nextPairId=previousPairId;
    memset(&alarms[previousCount],0,2*sizeof(Alarm));
    Serial.println("CREATE FAILED: new alarms not saved; original alarms preserved");
    return false;
  }
  createSaveError=false;
  Serial.println("CREATE SUCCESS: C1/C2 pair saved to NVS; acknowledging with two chirps");
  return true;
}

// ---------------------- TOUCH CALIBRATION --------------------------
// The exact same four-point calculation and Preferences layout/key as
// v1.00/v1.03; values stay in candidateCal until VERIFY -> SAVE.
static bool calibrationValid(const Calibration &v) {
  return v.magic==CAL_MAGIC &&
         abs(v.horizontalEnd-v.horizontalStart)>=60 &&
         abs(v.verticalEnd-v.verticalStart)>=60;
}
void startCalibration(bool fromSettings) {
  outputs(false);
  alertOn=false;
  candidateCal = {};
  calibrationStep=0;
  calibrationVerified=false;
  calibrationSaveFailed=false;
  calibrationFromSettings=fromSettings;
  // Calibration is a separate, non-timeout workflow. Exit -> SETTINGS
  // when launched there, or HOME for power-on/Serial calibration.
  navDepth=0;
  screen=CALIBRATE_TARGETS;
  lastActivity=millis();
  render();
  Serial.println("CAL: starting, old values retained until SAVE");
}
void exitCalibration(bool saved) {
  if(saved) {
    // Commit the new calibration to Preferences BEFORE replacing the
    // current working values; a failed write must not destroy the old ones.
    size_t n=prefs.putBytes("cal",&candidateCal,sizeof(candidateCal));
    Serial.printf("CAL: wrote %u of %u bytes\n",(unsigned)n,(unsigned)sizeof(candidateCal));
    if(n!=sizeof(candidateCal)) {
      calibrationSaveFailed=true;
      screen=CALIBRATE_VERIFY;
      render();
      return;
    }
    cal=candidateCal;
  } else Serial.println("CAL: cancelled; original calibration untouched");
  // From SETTINGS, return to its normal navigation stack: HOME <- SETTINGS.
  if(calibrationFromSettings && calibrationValid(cal)) {
    navDepth=1;
    navStack[0]=HOME;
    screen=SETTINGS;
    lastActivity=millis();
    render();
  } else if(calibrationValid(cal)) {
    goHome();
  } else {
    // If no working calibration exists, retry is mandatory; no UI can be
    // safely navigated using an invalid calibration.
    Serial.println("CAL: no previous valid calibration, restarting");
    startCalibration(false);
  }
}
bool mapRawPoint(int rawX,int rawY,const Calibration &config,int &x,int &y) {
  if(!calibrationValid(config))return false;
  int hx=config.swapAxes?rawY:rawX;
  int vy=config.swapAxes?rawX:rawY;
  x=map(hx,config.horizontalStart,config.horizontalEnd,CAL_MARGIN,SW-CAL_MARGIN);
  y=map(vy,config.verticalStart,config.verticalEnd,CAL_MARGIN,SH-CAL_MARGIN);
  x=constrain(x,0,SW-1);
  y=constrain(y,0,SH-1);
  return true;
}
void processCalibrationPoint(int rawX,int rawY) {
  if(screen!=CALIBRATE_TARGETS || calibrationStep>=4)return;
  calibrationPoints[calibrationStep]=TS_Point(rawX,rawY,0);
  Serial.printf("CAL point %d raw x=%d y=%d\n",calibrationStep+1,rawX,rawY);
  calibrationStep++;
  if(calibrationStep<4){render();return;}
  TS_Point *p=calibrationPoints;
  const int dx=(p[1].x+p[3].x-p[0].x-p[2].x)/2;
  const int dy=(p[1].y+p[3].y-p[0].y-p[2].y)/2;
  candidateCal.swapAxes=(abs(dy)>abs(dx))?1:0;
  auto horizontal=[](TS_Point point,bool swap)->int{return swap?point.y:point.x;};
  auto vertical=[](TS_Point point,bool swap)->int{return swap?point.x:point.y;};
  candidateCal.horizontalStart=(horizontal(p[0],candidateCal.swapAxes)+horizontal(p[2],candidateCal.swapAxes))/2;
  candidateCal.horizontalEnd=(horizontal(p[1],candidateCal.swapAxes)+horizontal(p[3],candidateCal.swapAxes))/2;
  candidateCal.verticalStart=(vertical(p[0],candidateCal.swapAxes)+vertical(p[1],candidateCal.swapAxes))/2;
  candidateCal.verticalEnd=(vertical(p[2],candidateCal.swapAxes)+vertical(p[3],candidateCal.swapAxes))/2;
  candidateCal.magic=CAL_MAGIC;
  calibrationSaveFailed=false;
  if(!calibrationValid(candidateCal)) {
    Serial.println("CAL: invalid target spacing; retry four targets");
    calibrationStep=0;
    candidateCal={};
    render();return;
  }
  calibrationVerified=false;
  screen=CALIBRATE_VERIFY;
  lastActivity=millis();
  render();
}
void onCalibrationVerifyTap(int x,int y) {
  if(contains(VERIFY_RETRY,x,y)) {
    calibrationStep=0;
    calibrationVerified=false;
    calibrationSaveFailed=false;
    screen=CALIBRATE_TARGETS;
    render();
  } else if(contains(VERIFY_SAVE,x,y)) {
    if(calibrationVerified)exitCalibration(true);
  } else if(contains(VERIFY_TARGET,x,y)) {
    // The central test point must be within 18px to permit SAVE.
    const int dx=x-160,dy=y-128;
    calibrationVerified=(dx*dx+dy*dy<=18*18);
    Serial.printf("CAL verify: x=%d y=%d result=%s\n",x,y,calibrationVerified?"GOOD":"OFF");
    render();
  } else {
    calibrationVerified=false;
    render();
  }
}
// ---------------------- USER INTERACTIONS --------------------------
// This precisely mirrors actionable touch regions; no beep on empty screen,
// disabled controls, or text-only cards. Screen changes remain in onTap().
static bool isAcceptedButtonTap(int x,int y) {
  switch(screen) {
    case HOME:
      return contains(HOME_CREATE,x,y) ||
             (countVisibleAlarms()>0 && contains(HOME_ALARMS,x,y)) ||
             contains(HOME_SETTINGS,x,y) ||
             (nextPending()>=0 && contains(HOME_DONE,x,y));
    case SETTINGS:
      return contains(SETTINGS_ROSTER,x,y) || contains(SETTINGS_RECIPES,x,y) ||
             contains(SETTINGS_COOLING,x,y) || contains(SETTINGS_COOKING,x,y) ||
             contains(SETTINGS_HOME,x,y) || contains(SETTINGS_ADVANCED,x,y);
    case COOLING_INFO: return contains({8,202,304,34},x,y);
    case COOKING_INFO:
      return contains(GUIDE_BACK,x,y) ||
             (contains(GUIDE_PREV,x,y) && cookingGuidePage>0) ||
             (contains(GUIDE_NEXT,x,y) && (cookingGuidePage+1)*COOKING_GUIDE_PER_PAGE<COOKING_GUIDE_ITEMS);
    case ADVANCED_SETTINGS:
      return contains(ADV_RESTART,x,y) || contains(ADV_CLEAR,x,y) ||
             contains(ADV_CALIBRATE,x,y) ||
             contains(ADV_BACK,x,y) || contains(ADV_HOME,x,y);
    case CALIBRATE_TARGETS: return false;
    case CALIBRATE_VERIFY:
      return contains(VERIFY_RETRY,x,y) ||
             (calibrationVerified && contains(VERIFY_SAVE,x,y));
    case VIEW_ALARMS:
      if(contains(LIST_NAV_HOME,x,y))return true;
      if(contains(LIST_NAV_PREV,x,y))return alarmFirst>0;
      if(contains(LIST_NAV_NEXT,x,y))return alarmFirst+ALARMS_PER_PAGE<visibleAlarmCount;
      for(int i=0;i<ALARMS_PER_PAGE;i++)if(contains(alarmCardAt(i),x,y))
        return alarmFirst+i<visibleAlarmCount;
      return false;
    case ALARM_DETAILS:
      return contains(DETAIL_BACK,x,y) ||
             (selectedAlarm>=0 && selectedAlarm<alarmCount &&
              (contains(DETAIL_EDIT,x,y) || contains(DETAIL_STATUS,x,y)));
    case VIEW_ROSTER:
      if(rosterForCreate || rosterForEdit) {
        if(contains(COOK_SELECT_BACK,x,y))return true;
        if(contains(COOK_SELECT_PREV,x,y))return rosterPage>0;
        if(contains(COOK_SELECT_NEXT,x,y))return (rosterPage+1)*COOK_SELECT_PER_PAGE<COOK_COUNT;
        for(int i=0;i<COOK_SELECT_PER_PAGE;i++)if(contains(cookSelectionCard(i),x,y))
          return rosterPage*COOK_SELECT_PER_PAGE+i<COOK_COUNT;
        return false;
      }
      if(contains(NAV_HOME,x,y))return true;
      if(contains(NAV_PREV,x,y))return rosterPage>0;
      if(contains(NAV_NEXT,x,y))return (rosterPage+1)*ROSTER_PER_PAGE<COOK_COUNT;
      for(int i=0;i<ROSTER_PER_PAGE;i++) {
        const Rect r=rosterCardAt(i);
        if(contains(r,x,y))return rosterPage*ROSTER_PER_PAGE+i<COOK_COUNT;
      }
      return false;
    case VIEW_RECIPES:
      if(contains(GUIDED_RECIPE_BACK,x,y))return true;
      if(contains(GUIDED_RECIPE_PREV,x,y))return viewRecipePage>0;
      if(contains(GUIDED_RECIPE_NEXT,x,y))return (viewRecipePage+1)*RECIPE_REFERENCE_PER_PAGE<RECIPE_COUNT;
      for(int r=0;r<RECIPE_REFERENCE_PER_PAGE;r++) {
        if(contains(guidedRecipeCard(r),x,y))
          return viewRecipePage*RECIPE_REFERENCE_PER_PAGE+r<RECIPE_COUNT;
      }
      return false;
    case RECIPE_INFO:
      return contains(RECIPE_INFO_BACK,x,y);
    case CHOOSE_RECIPE: return false; // Legacy intermediate screen disabled.
    case RECIPE_OPTIONS: {
      const int count=recipeOptionCount();
      if(optionField==FIELD_RECIPE) {
        if(contains(GUIDED_RECIPE_BACK,x,y))return true;
        if(contains(GUIDED_RECIPE_PREV,x,y))return recipePage>0;
        if(contains(GUIDED_RECIPE_NEXT,x,y))return (recipePage+1)*6<count;
        for(int i=0;i<6;i++)if(contains(guidedRecipeCard(i),x,y))
          return recipePage*6+i<count;
      } else {
        if(contains(GUIDED_BACK,x,y))return true;
        for(int i=0;i<6;i++)if(contains(guidedCategoryCard(i),x,y))return i<count;
      }
      return false;
    }
    case CREATE_ALARM:
      return contains(CREATE_COOK,x,y) || contains(CREATE_RECIPE,x,y) ||
             contains(CREATE_C1,x,y) || contains(CREATE_C2,x,y) ||
             contains(CREATE_CANCEL,x,y) ||
             (contains(CREATE_OK,x,y) && selectedCook>=0 && selectedRecipe>=0 &&
              allowNewCoolingPair() && createTimesValid());
    case EDIT_ALARM:
      return contains(EDIT_DISCARD,x,y) || contains(EDIT_SAVE,x,y) ||
             contains(EDIT_COOK,x,y) || contains(EDIT_CLOCK,x,y) ||
             contains(EDIT_RECIPE,x,y) || contains(EDIT_STATUS,x,y);
    case EDIT_TIME:
      return contains(editTimeAdjust(0),x,y) || contains(editTimeAdjust(1),x,y) ||
             contains(editTimeAdjust(2),x,y) || contains(editTimeAdjust(3),x,y) ||
             contains(EDITTIME_CANCEL,x,y) || contains(EDITTIME_SAVE,x,y);
    case CONFIRMATION:
      return contains(CONFIRM_NO,x,y) || contains(CONFIRM_YES,x,y);
    case ALARM_DUE:
      return contains(DUE_DONE,x,y) && dueAlarm>=0 && dueAlarm<alarmCount;
  }
  return false;
}
void onTap(int x,int y) {
  bool suppressNormalAck=false; // CREATE success uses 2 chirps, never 2+1.
  const bool acceptedButton = isAcceptedButtonTap(x,y);
  const bool confirmationResponse = acceptedButton && screen==CONFIRMATION &&
    (contains(CONFIRM_YES,x,y) || contains(CONFIRM_NO,x,y));
  // YES: double LED+buzzer pulse (60/20/60ms); NO: ordinary 20ms pulse.
  // Play only one pattern, before dispatch (important for Restart YES).
  if(confirmationResponse) {
    if(contains(CONFIRM_YES,x,y))acknowledgeConfirmation();
    else acknowledgeButton();
  }
  lastActivity=millis();
  Serial.printf("Tap x=%d y=%d screen=%d\n",x,y,(int)screen);
  switch(screen) {
    case HOME: {
      // Diagnostic confirms which button the stylus coordinates hit.
      const char *homeTarget=contains(HOME_ALARMS,x,y)?"View Alarms":
                             contains(HOME_SETTINGS,x,y)?"Settings":
                             contains(HOME_CREATE,x,y)?"Create Alarm":
                             contains(HOME_DONE,x,y)?"DONE":"none";
      Serial.printf("HOME HIT: %s (x=%d y=%d)\n",homeTarget,x,y);
      if(contains(HOME_CREATE,x,y)) {
        // Direct path to CREATE; no default cook or recipe.
        selectedCook=-1;selectedRecipe=-1;
        chosenVenue=-1;chosenType=-1;chosenRecipe=-1;
        createStartMin=nowMinutes();
        createC1Min=scheduledCoolingMinute(createStartMin,1);
        createC2Min=scheduledCoolingMinute(createStartMin,2);
        createSaveError=false;
        pushScreen(CREATE_ALARM);
      } else if(contains(HOME_ALARMS,x,y) && countVisibleAlarms()>0) {
        goViewAlarms();
      } else if(contains(HOME_SETTINGS,x,y)) {
        pushScreen(SETTINGS);
      } else if(contains(HOME_DONE,x,y)) {
        selectedAlarm=nextPending();
        if(selectedAlarm>=0)confirm(CA_HOME_DONE);
      }
      // The displayed alarm (HOME_INFO) is informational, not a button.
      break;
    }
    case SETTINGS: {
      if(contains(SETTINGS_ROSTER,x,y)) {
        rosterForEdit=false;rosterForCreate=false;rosterPage=0;
        rosterBrowseSelected=-1;selectCookPrepare();
        pushScreen(VIEW_ROSTER);
      } else if(contains(SETTINGS_RECIPES,x,y)) {
        viewRecipePage=0;viewRecipeSelected=-1;pushScreen(VIEW_RECIPES);
      } else if(contains(SETTINGS_COOLING,x,y)) {
        pushScreen(COOLING_INFO);
      } else if(contains(SETTINGS_COOKING,x,y)) {
        cookingGuidePage=0;pushScreen(COOKING_INFO);
      } else if(contains(SETTINGS_ADVANCED,x,y)) {
        pushScreen(ADVANCED_SETTINGS);
      } else if(contains(SETTINGS_HOME,x,y)) {
        goHome();
      }
      break;
    }
    case COOLING_INFO:
      if(contains({8,202,304,34},x,y))goBack();
      break;
    case COOKING_INFO:
      if(contains(GUIDE_BACK,x,y))goBack();
      else if(contains(GUIDE_PREV,x,y) && cookingGuidePage>0) {
        cookingGuidePage--;render();
      } else if(contains(GUIDE_NEXT,x,y) && (cookingGuidePage+1)*COOKING_GUIDE_PER_PAGE<COOKING_GUIDE_ITEMS) {
        cookingGuidePage++;render();
      }
      break;
    case ADVANCED_SETTINGS: {
      if(contains(ADV_RESTART,x,y))confirm(CA_RESTART_DEVICE);
      else if(contains(ADV_CLEAR,x,y))confirm(CA_CLEAR_ALL_ALARMS);
      else if(contains(ADV_CALIBRATE,x,y))confirm(CA_START_CALIBRATION);
      else if(contains(ADV_BACK,x,y))goBack();
      else if(contains(ADV_HOME,x,y))goHome();
      break;
    }
    case CALIBRATE_TARGETS: break; // raw touches handled before onTap()
    case CALIBRATE_VERIFY: {
      onCalibrationVerifyTap(x,y);
      break;
    }
    case VIEW_ALARMS: {
      if(contains(LIST_NAV_HOME,x,y)){goHome();break;}
      if(contains(LIST_NAV_PREV,x,y)) {
        if(alarmFirst>0){alarmPageOffset--;selectedAlarm=-1;render();}
        break;
      }
      if(contains(LIST_NAV_NEXT,x,y)) {
        if(alarmFirst+ALARMS_PER_PAGE<visibleAlarmCount){alarmPageOffset++;selectedAlarm=-1;render();}
        break;
      }
      for(int slot=0;slot<ALARMS_PER_PAGE;slot++) {
        if(!contains(alarmCardAt(slot),x,y))continue;
        const int p=alarmFirst+slot;
        sortAlarms();
        if(p<visibleAlarmCount) {
          selectedAlarm=sorted[p];
          detailPreviewStatus=alarms[selectedAlarm].status;
          detailPreviewChanged=false;
          pushScreen(ALARM_DETAILS);
        }
        break;
      }
      break;
    }
    case ALARM_DETAILS: {
      if(selectedAlarm<0 || selectedAlarm>=alarmCount) {
        if(contains(DETAIL_BACK,x,y))goBack();break;
      }
      if(contains(DETAIL_BACK,x,y)) {
        // Each tap cycles the PREVIEW only. BACK confirms a change once,
        // avoiding a false DONE record when user meant to CANCEL instead.
        if(!detailPreviewChanged ||
           detailPreviewStatus==alarms[selectedAlarm].status)goBack();
        else if(detailPreviewStatus==AlarmStatus::Done)confirm(CA_LIST_DONE);
        else if(detailPreviewStatus==AlarmStatus::Cancelled)confirm(CA_LIST_CANCEL);
        else if(!alarmPastDue(alarms[selectedAlarm]))confirm(CA_LIST_PENDING);
        else {
          // Clock reached due time after the user previewed PENDING.
          // Refuse to save a now-invalid status and offer DONE instead.
          detailPreviewStatus=AlarmStatus::Done;
          detailPreviewChanged=true;
          render();
        }
        break;
      }
      if(contains(DETAIL_EDIT,x,y)) {
        draft=alarms[selectedAlarm];
        if(detailPreviewChanged)draft.status=detailPreviewStatus;
        pushScreen(EDIT_ALARM);
      } else if(contains(DETAIL_STATUS,x,y)) {
        const Alarm &a=alarms[selectedAlarm];
        const AlarmStatus current=detailPreviewChanged?detailPreviewStatus:a.status;
        if(current==AlarmStatus::Pending)detailPreviewStatus=AlarmStatus::Done;
        else if(current==AlarmStatus::Done)detailPreviewStatus=AlarmStatus::Cancelled;
        else detailPreviewStatus=alarmPastDue(a)?AlarmStatus::Done:AlarmStatus::Pending;
        detailPreviewChanged=detailPreviewStatus!=a.status;
        render();
      }
      break;
    }
    case VIEW_ROSTER: {
      const bool selection=(rosterForEdit || rosterForCreate);
      if(selection && contains(COOK_SELECT_BACK,x,y)){goBack();break;}
      if(!selection && contains(NAV_HOME,x,y)){goHome();break;}
      if(contains(selection?COOK_SELECT_PREV:NAV_PREV,x,y)){
        if(rosterPage>0)rosterPage--;render();break;
      }
      if(contains(selection?COOK_SELECT_NEXT:NAV_NEXT,x,y)){
        if((rosterPage+1)*(selection?COOK_SELECT_PER_PAGE:ROSTER_PER_PAGE)<COOK_COUNT)
          rosterPage++;
        render();break;
      }
      const int perPage=selection?COOK_SELECT_PER_PAGE:ROSTER_PER_PAGE;
      for(int i=0;i<perPage;i++) {
        const int offset=rosterPage*perPage+i;
        if(offset>=COOK_COUNT)break;
        const int ci=cookSelectOrder[offset];
        const Rect r=selection?cookSelectionCard(i):rosterCardAt(i);
        if(contains(r,x,y)) {
          if(rosterForEdit) {
            copyText(draft.initials,sizeof(draft.initials),cooks[ci].initials);
            goBack(); // EDIT ALARM
          } else if(rosterForCreate) {
            selectedCook=ci;
            goBack(); // CREATE ALARM
          } else {
            rosterBrowseSelected=ci;render(); // SETTINGS browse only
          }
          break;
        }
      }
      break;
    }
    case VIEW_RECIPES: {
      if(contains(GUIDED_RECIPE_BACK,x,y)){goBack();break;}
      if(contains(GUIDED_RECIPE_PREV,x,y)){if(viewRecipePage>0)viewRecipePage--;render();break;}
      if(contains(GUIDED_RECIPE_NEXT,x,y)){if((viewRecipePage+1)*RECIPE_REFERENCE_PER_PAGE<RECIPE_COUNT)viewRecipePage++;render();break;}
      for(int r=0;r<RECIPE_REFERENCE_PER_PAGE;r++) {
        if(!contains(guidedRecipeCard(r),x,y))continue;
        const int sortedIndex=viewRecipePage*RECIPE_REFERENCE_PER_PAGE+r;
        if(sortedIndex<RECIPE_COUNT) {
          viewRecipeSelected=recipeOrder[sortedIndex];
          pushScreen(RECIPE_INFO);
        }
        break;
      }
      break; // Read-only; recipe selections do not change any alarm.
    }
    case RECIPE_INFO: {
      if(contains(RECIPE_INFO_BACK,x,y))goBack(); // same View Recipes page
      break;
    }
    case CHOOSE_RECIPE: break;
    case RECIPE_OPTIONS: {
      const int count=recipeOptionCount();
      if(optionField==FIELD_RECIPE) {
        if(contains(GUIDED_RECIPE_BACK,x,y)){guidedGoBack();break;}
        if(contains(GUIDED_RECIPE_PREV,x,y)){
          if(recipePage>0){recipePage--;render();}break;
        }
        if(contains(GUIDED_RECIPE_NEXT,x,y)){
          if((recipePage+1)*6<count){recipePage++;render();}break;
        }
        for(int i=0;i<6;i++)if(contains(guidedRecipeCard(i),x,y)) {
          const int option=recipePage*6+i;
          if(option<count)guidedChoose(option);
          break;
        }
      } else {
        if(contains(GUIDED_BACK,x,y)){guidedGoBack();break;}
        for(int i=0;i<6;i++)if(contains(guidedCategoryCard(i),x,y)) {
          if(i<count)guidedChoose(i);
          break;
        }
      }
      break;
    }
    case CREATE_ALARM: {
      if(contains(CREATE_COOK,x,y)) {
        rosterForEdit=false;rosterForCreate=true;
        rosterPage=0;selectCookPrepare();pushScreen(VIEW_ROSTER);
      } else if(contains(CREATE_RECIPE,x,y)) {
        openChooseRecipe(false); // Big buttons; venue > type > recipe, no keyboard
      } else if(contains(CREATE_C1,x,y)) {
        enterTimeEditor(1,true);
      } else if(contains(CREATE_C2,x,y)) {
        enterTimeEditor(2,true);
      } else if(contains(CREATE_CANCEL,x,y)) {
        goHome();
      } else if(contains(CREATE_OK,x,y) && selectedCook>=0 &&
                selectedRecipe>=0 && allowNewCoolingPair() && createTimesValid()) {
        suppressNormalAck=true;
        if(createPairImmediately()) {
          acknowledgeConfirmation(); // buzzer-only double chirp; no confirmation screen
          goHome();
        } else {
          createSaveError=true;
          render();
        }
      }
      break;
    }
    case EDIT_ALARM: {
      if(contains(EDIT_DISCARD,x,y))goViewAlarms();
      else if(contains(EDIT_SAVE,x,y))confirm(CA_SAVE_EDIT);
      else if(contains(EDIT_COOK,x,y)) {
        rosterForEdit=true;rosterForCreate=false;rosterPage=0;selectCookPrepare();pushScreen(VIEW_ROSTER);
      } else if(contains(EDIT_CLOCK,x,y))enterTimeEditor(draft.stage,false);
      else if(contains(EDIT_RECIPE,x,y)) {
        openChooseRecipe(true);
      } else if(contains(EDIT_STATUS,x,y)) {
        draft.status=draft.status==AlarmStatus::Pending?AlarmStatus::Done:
          draft.status==AlarmStatus::Done?AlarmStatus::Cancelled:
          alarmPastDue(draft)?AlarmStatus::Done:AlarmStatus::Pending;
        render();
      }
      break;
    }
    case EDIT_TIME: {
      if(contains(EDITTIME_CANCEL,x,y)){goBack();break;} // Discard staged changes
      if(contains(EDITTIME_SAVE,x,y)) {
        if(editTimeFromCreate) {
          if(editTimeStage==1)createC1Min=editTimeCandidate;
          else createC2Min=editTimeCandidate;
        } else {
          const int old=draft.whenMin;
          draft.whenMin=editTimeCandidate;
          if(draft.dueEpoch>0)
            draft.dueEpoch+=(int64_t)(draft.whenMin-old)*60LL;
        }
        goBack();break;
      }
      int delta=0;
      if(contains(editTimeAdjust(0),x,y))delta=-60;
      else if(contains(editTimeAdjust(1),x,y))delta=-5;
      else if(contains(editTimeAdjust(2),x,y))delta=5;
      else if(contains(editTimeAdjust(3),x,y))delta=60;
      const int proposed=editTimeCandidate+delta;
      editTimeCandidate=constrain(proposed,0,deviceTestMode?2879:LAST_COOK_ALARM_MINUTE);
      render();break;
    }
    case CONFIRMATION:
      if(contains(CONFIRM_NO,x,y))goBack();
      else if(contains(CONFIRM_YES,x,y))yesConfirmation();
      break;
    case ALARM_DUE:
      if(contains(DUE_DONE,x,y))ackDue();
      break;
  }
  if(acceptedButton && !confirmationResponse && !suppressNormalAck)
    acknowledgeButton();
}

// ---------------------- STARTUP WI-FI / OTA / NTP -------------------
// Reuses the tested 3-button Break Monitor's priority and manifest format.
// The radios are OFF during normal operation; RSSI is only sampled once.
void startupMessage(const String& heading,const String& detail,const String& footer) {
  // Same STARTUP line goes to Serial Monitor AND the scrolling LCD log.
  Serial.printf("STARTUP: %s | %s | %s\n",heading.c_str(),detail.c_str(),footer.c_str());
  startupLogAdd(String("SCREEN: ")+heading+" | "+detail+" | "+footer);
  bootLogShow(false);
}
void startupProgress(int percent) {
  nativeProgress(percent);
}
bool waitForStartupWifi(uint32_t timeoutMs) {
  const uint32_t began=millis();
  while((uint32_t)(millis()-began)<timeoutMs) {
    if(WiFi.status()==WL_CONNECTED)return true;
    delay(100);
  }
  return WiFi.status()==WL_CONNECTED;
}
bool connectStartupWiFi() {
  startupRSSIValid=false;
  startupMessage("SCANNING WIFI","Known networks","Work preferred; home fallback");
  WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA);
  delay(750); // Same 2-stage radio wake as the Break Log.
  WiFi.setAutoReconnect(false);
  WiFi.persistent(false);
  const int count=WiFi.scanNetworks();
  bool workFound=false,homeFound=false;
  const bool homeConfigured = homeWiFiSSID.length()>0;
  for(int i=0;i<count;i++) {
    const String ssid=WiFi.SSID(i);
    if(ssid==WORK_WIFI_SSID)workFound=true;
    if(homeConfigured && ssid==homeWiFiSSID)homeFound=true;
  }
  WiFi.scanDelete();
  bool connected=false;
  if(workFound) {
    for(int attempt=1;attempt<=2 && !connected;attempt++) {
      startupMessage("CONNECTING WIFI",String("Work (attempt ")+String(attempt)+")","6-second attempt");
      if(WORK_WIFI_PASSWORD[0] == '\0') {
         WiFi.begin(WORK_WIFI_SSID); // Open network: no password argument.
       } else {
         WiFi.begin(WORK_WIFI_SSID,WORK_WIFI_PASSWORD);
       }
      connected=waitForStartupWifi(WIFI_ATTEMPT_MS);
      if(!connected) {WiFi.disconnect(true);delay(500);WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA);}
    }
  }
  if(!connected && homeFound) {
    startupMessage("CONNECTING WIFI","Home fallback","6-second attempt");
    WiFi.begin(homeWiFiSSID.c_str(),homeWiFiPassword.c_str());
    connected=waitForStartupWifi(WIFI_ATTEMPT_MS);
  }
  if(connected) {
    startupRSSI=WiFi.RSSI();
    startupRSSIValid=true;
    startupMessage("WIFI CONNECTED",WiFi.SSID(),String("RSSI ")+String(startupRSSI)+" dBm");
    return true;
  }
  startupMessage("WIFI UNAVAILABLE","Offline mode","No OTA / no verified clock");
  return false;
}
// ============================================================
// GITHUB OTA -- DIRECT PORT OF THE WORKING BREAK LOG PROJECT
// Break Log source: PFDS_Break_Monitor_ESP32_v1.13.txt
// Only the CYD display, repository URL, and startup logging differ.
// ============================================================

// Exact Break Log version comparison implementation.
int versionPart(const String& version, int partIndex) {
  String v = version;
  v.trim();

  if (v.startsWith("v") || v.startsWith("V")) {
    v.remove(0, 1);
  }

  int values[3] = {0, 0, 0};
  int currentPart = 0;
  String token = "";

  for (int i = 0; i <= (int)v.length() && currentPart < 3; i++) {
    char c = (i < (int)v.length()) ? v[i] : '.';

    if (c == '.') {
      values[currentPart++] = token.toInt();
      token = "";
    } else if (isDigit(c)) {
      token += c;
    }
  }

  return values[partIndex];
}

bool isVersionNewer(const String& availableVersion,
                    const String& installedVersion) {
  for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    int available = versionPart(availableVersion, i);
    int installed = versionPart(installedVersion, i);

    if (available > installed) return true;
    if (available < installed) return false;
  }

  return false;
}

// Exact Break Log HTTPS request scope and timeout pattern. The secure
// client AND HTTPClient are both destroyed when this function returns,
// before HTTPUpdate creates the firmware-download TLS connection.
bool otaManifestGetTextOnce(const String& url, String& response) {
  if (WiFi.status() != WL_CONNECTED) {
    Serial.println("[OTA] HTTP skipped: WiFi not connected.");
    startupLogAdd("OTA manifest: no WiFi");
    return false;
  }

  WiFiClientSecure client;
  client.setInsecure();
  client.setTimeout(20000);

  HTTPClient http;
  http.setFollowRedirects(HTTPC_STRICT_FOLLOW_REDIRECTS);
  http.setConnectTimeout(20000);
  http.setTimeout(20000);

  Serial.println("[OTA] HTTP GET firmware manifest");
  if (!http.begin(client, url)) {
    Serial.println("[OTA] HTTP begin FAILED.");
    startupLogAdd("OTA manifest: BEGIN FAILED");
    return false;
  }

  int code = http.GET();
  Serial.print("[OTA] HTTP status: ");
  Serial.println(code);
  startupLogAdd("OTA manifest HTTP=" + String(code));

  if (code != HTTP_CODE_OK) {
    http.end();
    return false;
  }

  response = http.getString();
  Serial.print("[OTA] Manifest payload bytes: ");
  Serial.println(response.length());
  http.end();
  return true;
}

bool otaManifestGetText(const String& url, String& response) {
  response = "";
  if (otaManifestGetTextOnce(url, response)) {
    return true;
  }

  // Break Log / Recipe Scaler: one retry for an idle HTTPS endpoint.
  Serial.println("[OTA] HTTP failed or timed out; retrying once...");
  delay(500);
  response = "";
  if (otaManifestGetTextOnce(url, response)) {
    Serial.println("[OTA] HTTP retry: SUCCESS");
    return true;
  }
  Serial.println("[OTA] HTTP retry: FAILED");
  return false;
}

void performGitHubOTAUpdateCheck() {
  Serial.println();
  Serial.println("[GITHUB OTA -- BREAK LOG]");
  Serial.print("Installed firmware: ");
  Serial.println(FIRMWARE_VERSION);

  startupMessage("CHECKING FIRMWARE", FIRMWARE_VERSION, "Freenove-specific OTA manifest");
  if(!GITHUB_OTA_MANIFEST_URL[0] || !FREENOVE_OTA_RELEASE_PREFIX[0]) {
    Serial.println("[OTA] Freenove test manifest not configured; production ELEGOO URL is blocked");
    startupLogAdd("OTA test manifest not configured (hardware safety)");
    startupMessage("OTA ISOLATED", "Freenove test hardware", "Production binary blocked");
    delay(600);
    return;
  }

  String manifestPayload;
  if (!otaManifestGetText(String(GITHUB_OTA_MANIFEST_URL), manifestPayload)) {
    Serial.println("GitHub manifest download: FAILED");
    startupLogAdd("GitHub manifest download: FAILED");
    startupMessage("OTA CHECK FAILED", "GitHub unavailable", "Keeping installed firmware");
    delay(900);
    return;
  }

  DynamicJsonDocument manifest(2048);
  DeserializationError err = deserializeJson(manifest, manifestPayload);
  if (err) {
    Serial.print("GitHub manifest JSON error: ");
    Serial.println(err.c_str());
    startupLogAdd("OTA manifest JSON error: " + String(err.c_str()));
    startupMessage("OTA CHECK FAILED", "Invalid manifest", "Keeping installed firmware");
    delay(900);
    return;
  }

  String availableVersion = String((const char*)(manifest["version"] | ""));
  String firmwareUrl = String((const char*)(manifest["url"] | ""));
  availableVersion.trim();
  firmwareUrl.trim();

  Serial.print("GitHub firmware: ");
  Serial.println(availableVersion.length() ? availableVersion : "MISSING");
  startupLogAdd("OTA manifest available version: " + availableVersion);

  if (availableVersion.length() == 0) {
    Serial.println("OTA manifest missing version.");
    startupLogAdd("OTA manifest: missing version");
    return;
  }

  if (!isVersionNewer(availableVersion, String(FIRMWARE_VERSION))) {
    Serial.println("Firmware is current. No OTA update required.");
    startupMessage("FIRMWARE CURRENT", FIRMWARE_VERSION, "No update needed");
    delay(650);
    return;
  }

  if (firmwareUrl.length() == 0) {
    Serial.println("New firmware listed, but URL is missing.");
    startupLogAdd("OTA manifest: missing download URL");
    startupMessage("OTA CONFIG ERROR", "Firmware URL empty", "Keeping current");
    delay(1200);
    return;
  }
  // This CYD project uses its own public release repository; refuse a
  // manifest that unexpectedly requests firmware from another repository.
  // This validation does not alter the Break Log HTTPS download sequence.
  if (!firmwareUrl.startsWith(String(FREENOVE_OTA_RELEASE_PREFIX))) {
    Serial.println("OTA URL is not from the configured release repository.");
    startupLogAdd("OTA manifest: unexpected release URL");
    startupMessage("OTA CONFIG ERROR", "Invalid release URL", "Keeping current");
    return;
  }

  Serial.println();
  Serial.println("NEW FIRMWARE AVAILABLE");
  Serial.print("Current: ");
  Serial.println(FIRMWARE_VERSION);
  Serial.print("New: ");
  Serial.println(availableVersion);
  Serial.print("URL: ");
  Serial.println(firmwareUrl);
  startupLogAdd("OTA available version: " + availableVersion);

  startupMessage("FIRMWARE UPDATE", String(FIRMWARE_VERSION) + " to " + availableVersion,
                 "DO NOT POWER OFF");

  // Critical Break Log behavior: one fresh secure client and one HTTPUpdate.
  // No redirect probing, direct-CDN retry, or parallel HTTP client.
  WiFiClientSecure otaClient;
  otaClient.setInsecure();
  otaClient.setTimeout(30000);

  httpUpdate.setFollowRedirects(HTTPC_STRICT_FOLLOW_REDIRECTS);
  httpUpdate.rebootOnUpdate(true);

  httpUpdate.onProgress([](int current, int total) {
    if (total <= 0) return;

    int percent = (int)((current * 100LL) / total);
    if (percent < 0) percent = 0;
    if (percent > 100) percent = 100;
    startupProgress(percent);
  });

  // Capture the state before the OTA attempt; the ESP32 normally reboots
  // automatically on success, so this line may be the last boot diagnostic.
  startupLogAdd("OTA transfer start: freeHeap=" +
                String((unsigned int)ESP.getFreeHeap()));
  t_httpUpdate_return result = httpUpdate.update(otaClient, firmwareUrl);

  switch (result) {
    case HTTP_UPDATE_FAILED: {
      const int code = httpUpdate.getLastError();
      String description = httpUpdate.getLastErrorString();
      Serial.print("OTA FAILED: ");
      Serial.print(code);
      Serial.print(" - ");
      Serial.println(description);
      startupLogAdd("OTA FAILED: code=" + String(code) +
                    " description=" +
                    (description.length() ? description : String("(empty)")));
      startupMessage("OTA UPDATE FAILED", "Keeping current", "See startup Log");
      delay(1400);
      return;
    }

    case HTTP_UPDATE_NO_UPDATES:
      Serial.println("OTA library reported NO UPDATE.");
      startupLogAdd("OTA library reported NO UPDATE");
      return;

    case HTTP_UPDATE_OK:
      Serial.println("OTA SUCCESS. Restarting...");
      startupLogAdd("OTA SUCCESS. Restarting...");
      startupMessage("OTA SUCCESS", "RESTARTING...", "DO NOT POWER OFF");
      delay(500);
      // The Break Log library normally restarts automatically first.
      ESP.restart();
      return;
  }
}
