void onFreshNtpTime(struct timeval* received) {
  (void)received;
  freshNTPSync=true;
}
bool synchronizeClockFromNTP() {
  startupMessage("SYNCING CLOCK","NTP / Vancouver","Waiting for verified time...");
  freshNTPSync=false;
  sntp_set_time_sync_notification_cb(onFreshNtpTime);
  configTzTime(configuredTimezone.c_str(),NTP_1,NTP_2);
  const uint32_t started=millis();
  struct tm date={};
  while((uint32_t)(millis()-started)<NTP_WAIT_MS) {
    if(freshNTPSync && getLocalTime(&date,250) && date.tm_year+1900>=2025) {
      timeSynced=true;
      startupMessage("CLOCK SYNCED",currentHeaderDate(),clockHMS());
      return true;
    }
    delay(50);
  }
  timeSynced=false;
  startupMessage("CLOCK NOT VERIFIED","Demo time only","Automatic due alarms held");
  return false;
}
void shutdownStartupRadios() {
  // Capture RSSI already done. Do not read it again after shutdown.
  WiFi.disconnect(true,true);
  WiFi.mode(WIFI_OFF);
  btStop();
  Serial.println("Wi-Fi OFF / Bluetooth OFF; startup RSSI remains static");
}

// ---------------------- CONDITIONAL SHEETS DATA --------------------
// Apps Script GET endpoints: ?action=flag, ?action=data, ?action=ack
// The API key is stored privately in NVS. Config is downloaded on EVERY
// successful startup; roster and recipes only when the flag says Yes.
// Roster filtering occurs on the server AND client.
static const char* DATA_FILE="/cool_data.json";
static const char* DATA_TEMP="/cool_data.tmp";
static const char* DATA_BACKUP="/cool_data.bak";
static bool fsReady=false;

String normalizeLabel(String text) {
  text.trim();text.toLowerCase();return text;
}
int lookupVenue(const String &name) {
  String needle=normalizeLabel(name);
  for(int i=0;i<VENUE_COUNT;i++)
    if(normalizeLabel(String(VENUES[i]))==needle)return i;
  return -1;
}
int lookupRecipeType(const String &name) {
  String needle=normalizeLabel(name);
  for(int i=0;i<TYPE_COUNT;i++)
    if(normalizeLabel(String(TYPES[i]))==needle)return i;
  return -1;
}
// Validate the WHOLE dataset before changing any live arrays or local file.
// The cache never stores unrelated roles or recipes with InUse!=Yes.
static String sheetValidationError="";
bool sheetValidationReject(const String& reason) {
  sheetValidationError=reason;
  startupLogAdd("Sheet dataset validation rejected: " + reason);
  Serial.println("Sheet dataset validation rejected: " + reason);
  return false;
}
// Google Sheets returns display-formatted times (e.g. "8:00 AM" and
// "10:30 PM"). Accept optional seconds or 24-hour HH:MM too.
int parseStoreClockMinute(String s) {
  s.trim();s.toUpperCase();
  const bool am=s.endsWith("AM"),pm=s.endsWith("PM");
  if(am||pm){s.remove((int)s.length()-2);s.trim();}
  int h=-1,m=-1,seconds=0;
  const int found=sscanf(s.c_str(),"%d:%d:%d",&h,&m,&seconds);
  if(found<2 || m<0 || m>59 || seconds<0 || seconds>59)return -1;
  if(am||pm) {
    if(h<1 || h>12)return -1;
    h=(h%12)+(pm?12:0);
  } else if(h<0 || h>23)return -1;
  return h*60+m;
}
bool parseSheetDataset(const String& payload,bool apply) {
  sheetValidationError="";
  if(payload.length()==0 || payload.length()>30000)return sheetValidationReject("EMPTY_OR_OVERSIZE_RESPONSE");
  DynamicJsonDocument doc(50000);
  if(deserializeJson(doc,payload))return sheetValidationReject("INVALID_JSON");
  // Accept older v1.12 local caches while new endpoint uses Break Log success=true.
  if(!(doc["success"] | false) && !(doc["ok"] | false))return sheetValidationReject("APP_RESPONSE_NOT_SUCCESS");
  JsonObjectConst conf=doc["config"].as<JsonObjectConst>();
  JsonArrayConst roster=doc["cooks"].as<JsonArrayConst>();
  JsonArrayConst catalog=doc["recipes"].as<JsonArrayConst>();
  if(conf.isNull()||roster.isNull()||catalog.isNull())return sheetValidationReject("MISSING_CONFIG_COOKS_OR_RECIPES");
  int inactivity=conf["inactivitySeconds"] | 5;
  if(inactivity<1 || inactivity>180)return sheetValidationReject("INVALID_INACTIVITY_SECONDS");
  String openTime=String((const char*)(conf["storeOpenTime"] | ""));
  String closeTime=String((const char*)(conf["storeCloseTime"] | ""));
  // The Apps Script action=data response must return "deviceMode" from
  // Config.DeviceMode. The old local cache may omit it for compatibility.
  String mode=String((const char*)(conf["deviceMode"] | ""));
  mode.trim(); mode.toUpperCase();
  if(mode.length()>0 && mode!="TEST" && mode!="PRODUCTION")
    return sheetValidationReject("INVALID_DEVICE_MODE");
  // During a new download, refuse to ACK until the deployed Apps Script
  // includes the new field; otherwise Test could silently act as Production.
  if(!apply && mode.length()==0)
    return sheetValidationReject("MISSING_DEVICE_MODE_IN_SERVER_DATA");
  if(openTime.length()>16 || closeTime.length()>16)return sheetValidationReject("STORE_TIME_TOO_LONG");
  int parsedOpen=parseStoreClockMinute(openTime);
  int parsedClose=parseStoreClockMinute(closeTime);
  if(parsedOpen<0 || parsedClose<0 || parsedOpen==parsedClose ||
     (parsedOpen+1440-PREOPEN_LEAD_MINUTES)%1440==parsedClose)
    return sheetValidationReject("INVALID_STORE_OPEN_OR_CLOSE_TIME");
  int newCookCount=0,newRecipeCount=0;
  char validatedInitials[MAX_COOKS][4] = {}; // ~240 bytes, on stack
  for(JsonObjectConst entry:roster) {
    if(newCookCount>=MAX_COOKS)return sheetValidationReject("TOO_MANY_COOKS");
    String name=String((const char*)(entry["name"] | ""));
    String initials=String((const char*)(entry["initials"] | ""));
    name.trim();initials.trim();initials.toUpperCase();
    if(name.length()==0 || name.length()>=sizeof(cooks[0].name) ||
       initials.length()==0 || initials.length()>3)return sheetValidationReject("INVALID_COOK_NAME_OR_INITIALS");
    for(int i=0;i<newCookCount;i++)
      if(initials.equals(String(validatedInitials[i])))return sheetValidationReject("DUPLICATE_COOK_INITIALS");
    copyText(validatedInitials[newCookCount],sizeof(validatedInitials[0]),initials.c_str());
    ++newCookCount;
  }
  for(JsonObjectConst entry:catalog) {
    if(newRecipeCount>=MAX_RECIPES)return sheetValidationReject("TOO_MANY_RECIPES");
    String item=String((const char*)(entry["item"] | ""));
    String venueName=String((const char*)(entry["venue"] | ""));
    String typeName=String((const char*)(entry["type"] | ""));
    item.trim();
    int venue=lookupVenue(venueName),type=lookupRecipeType(typeName);
    if(item.length()==0 || item.length()>=sizeof(recipes[0].name) ||
       venue<0 || type<0)return sheetValidationReject("INVALID_RECIPE_ITEM_VENUE_OR_TYPE");
    ++newRecipeCount;
  }
  // Do not mutate working data if any part of the payload was invalid.
  if(newCookCount==0 || newRecipeCount==0)return sheetValidationReject("EMPTY_COOKS_OR_ACTIVE_RECIPES");
  if(apply) {
    // Second pass is safe: every field and the full dataset were validated.
    int ci=0;
    for(JsonObjectConst entry:roster) {
      String name=String((const char*)(entry["name"] | ""));
      String initials=String((const char*)(entry["initials"] | ""));
      name.trim();initials.trim();initials.toUpperCase();
      copyText(cooks[ci].name,sizeof(cooks[ci].name),name.c_str());
      copyText(cooks[ci].initials,sizeof(cooks[ci].initials),initials.c_str());
      ++ci;
    }
    int ri=0;
    for(JsonObjectConst entry:catalog) {
      String item=String((const char*)(entry["item"] | ""));
      String venueName=String((const char*)(entry["venue"] | ""));
      String typeName=String((const char*)(entry["type"] | ""));
      item.trim();
      copyText(recipes[ri].name,sizeof(recipes[ri].name),item.c_str());
      recipes[ri].venue=(uint8_t)lookupVenue(venueName);
      recipes[ri].type=(uint8_t)lookupRecipeType(typeName);
      ++ri;
    }
    COOK_COUNT=newCookCount;
    RECIPE_COUNT=newRecipeCount;
    if(!runtimeConfigLoaded) {
      idleTimeoutMs=(uint32_t)inactivity*1000UL;
      storeOpenTime=openTime;storeCloseTime=closeTime;
    }
    if(!runtimeConfigLoaded) {
      configuredOpenMinute=parsedOpen;
      configuredCloseMinute=parsedClose;
    }
    if(!runtimeConfigLoaded && mode.length()>0) {
      const bool newTestMode=(mode=="TEST");
      // Avoid unnecessary flash writes on every cache read or reboot.
      if(newTestMode!=deviceTestMode) {
        if(!prefs.putBool("dev_test",newTestMode))
          Serial.println("WARNING: DeviceMode NVS save FAILED");
      }
      deviceTestMode=newTestMode;
      Serial.printf("Config.DeviceMode: %s\n",deviceTestMode?"Test":"Production");
    }
    dataCacheAvailable=true;
    // Invalidated UI selections from an old menu must not be reused.
    selectedCook=-1;selectedRecipe=-1;chosenRecipe=-1;rosterPage=0;recipePage=0;
  }
  return true;
}

bool saveSheetDataAtomic(const String& payload) {
  if(!fsReady)return false;
  LittleFS.remove(DATA_TEMP);
  fs::File f=LittleFS.open(DATA_TEMP,"w");
  if(!f)return false;
  size_t written=f.print(payload);
  f.close();
  if(written!=payload.length()) {LittleFS.remove(DATA_TEMP);return false;}
  // Retain previous known-good dataset until the new file is committed.
  LittleFS.remove(DATA_BACKUP);
  bool hadOld=LittleFS.exists(DATA_FILE);
  if(hadOld && !LittleFS.rename(DATA_FILE,DATA_BACKUP)) {
    LittleFS.remove(DATA_TEMP);return false;
  }
  if(!LittleFS.rename(DATA_TEMP,DATA_FILE)) {
    if(hadOld)LittleFS.rename(DATA_BACKUP,DATA_FILE);
    LittleFS.remove(DATA_TEMP);
    return false;
  }
  LittleFS.remove(DATA_BACKUP);
  return true;
}

bool loadLocalSheetData() {
  if(!fsReady)return false;
  // Recover interrupted cache replacement on an earlier power loss.
  if(!LittleFS.exists(DATA_FILE) && LittleFS.exists(DATA_BACKUP))
    LittleFS.rename(DATA_BACKUP,DATA_FILE);
  if(!LittleFS.exists(DATA_FILE))return false;
  fs::File f=LittleFS.open(DATA_FILE,"r");
  if(!f)return false;
  if(f.size()>30000) {f.close();return false;}
  String payload=f.readString();f.close();
  if(!parseSheetDataset(payload,true)) {
    Serial.println("Sheet cache invalid; keeping no/previous data");
    return false;
  }
  Serial.printf("Local cache loaded: cooks=%d activeRecipes=%d inactivity=%lums\n",
    COOK_COUNT,RECIPE_COUNT,(unsigned long)idleTimeoutMs);
  return true;
}

// Break Log-compatible: GET ?action=flag|data|ack&token=...
// Diagnostics use the action name, HTTP code, payload length and error only.
// NEVER log the request URL because its query contains the private API key.
static int sheetLastHTTPStatus = 0;
static int sheetLastHTTPBytes = 0;
static String sheetLastHTTPError = "";
static unsigned long sheetLastHTTPElapsedMs = 0;
static int sheetLastHTTPAttempts = 0;
static const size_t SHEET_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES = 30000;

String sheetApiRequestURL(const char* action) {
  String url(GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL);
  url += (url.indexOf('?')>=0 ? "&" : "?");
  url += "action=";
  url += action;
  url += "&token=";
  url += sheetAPIToken; // Stored privately in NVS; never printed.
  return url;
}

// Uses the same Break Log HTTPS GET transport:
// independent secure client, strict redirect following, 20s timeouts.
bool sheetGetOnce(const String& url, String& response) {
  response = "";
  sheetLastHTTPStatus = 0;
  sheetLastHTTPBytes = 0;
  sheetLastHTTPError = "";
  if (WiFi.status()!=WL_CONNECTED) {
    sheetLastHTTPError="NO WIFI";
    return false;
  }

  WiFiClientSecure client;
  client.setInsecure(); // Same working Break Log setup; HTTPS cert not verified.
  client.setTimeout(20000);

  HTTPClient http;
  http.setFollowRedirects(HTTPC_STRICT_FOLLOW_REDIRECTS);
  http.setConnectTimeout(20000);
  http.setTimeout(20000);

  if (!http.begin(client, url)) {
    sheetLastHTTPError="BEGIN FAILED";
    return false;
  }
  const int status=http.GET();
  sheetLastHTTPStatus=status;
  if (status!=HTTP_CODE_OK) {
    sheetLastHTTPError = status<0 ? ("HTTP TRANSPORT " + String(status))
                                   : ("HTTP " + String(status));
    http.end();
    return false;
  }

  response=http.getString();
  http.end();
  sheetLastHTTPBytes=(int)response.length();
  if (response.isEmpty()) {
    sheetLastHTTPError="EMPTY RESPONSE";
    return false;
  }
  if (response.length()>SHEET_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES) {
    sheetLastHTTPError="RESPONSE TOO LARGE";
    response="";
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

// As in Break Log, retry a failed GET once after 500ms. Apps Script's
// first request after being idle can occasionally fail or time out.
bool sheetGet(const char* action, String& result) {
  result="";
  if (sheetAPIToken.length()==0) {
    sheetLastHTTPError="PRIVATE TOKEN NOT CONFIGURED";
    return false;
  }
  if (WiFi.status()!=WL_CONNECTED) {
    sheetLastHTTPError="NO WIFI";
    return false;
  }
  const String url=sheetApiRequestURL(action);
  const unsigned long started=millis();
  sheetLastHTTPAttempts=0;
  for (int attempt=1;attempt<=2;attempt++) {
    sheetLastHTTPAttempts=attempt;
    if (sheetGetOnce(url,result)) {
      sheetLastHTTPElapsedMs=millis()-started;
      Serial.printf("Sheets %s: OK HTTP=%d bytes=%d attempts=%d elapsed=%lums\n",
                    action,sheetLastHTTPStatus,sheetLastHTTPBytes,
                    attempt,sheetLastHTTPElapsedMs);
      startupLogAdd(String("Sheets ")+action+" OK | HTTP="+String(sheetLastHTTPStatus)+
                    " bytes="+String(sheetLastHTTPBytes)+" attempts="+String(attempt)+
                    " elapsedMs="+String(sheetLastHTTPElapsedMs));
      return true;
    }
    // No response body from a failed request is ever used for validation.
    Serial.printf("Sheets %s: attempt %d failed HTTP=%d error=%s\n",
                  action,attempt,sheetLastHTTPStatus,sheetLastHTTPError.c_str());
    result="";
    if (attempt==1)delay(500);
  }
  sheetLastHTTPElapsedMs=millis()-started;
  startupLogAdd(String("Sheets ")+action+" FAILED | HTTP="+String(sheetLastHTTPStatus)+
                " attempts="+String(sheetLastHTTPAttempts)+" elapsedMs="+
                String(sheetLastHTTPElapsedMs)+" error="+sheetLastHTTPError);
  return false;
}

// A Google Apps Script error often returns HTTP 200 with {ok:false}.
// Surface that meaningful error without logging tokens or URL parameters.
void sheetReportAppError(const char* action,const String& response) {
  DynamicJsonDocument responseDoc(1024);
  if (!deserializeJson(responseDoc,response)) {
    String error=String((const char*)(responseDoc["error"] | ""));
    error.trim();
    if(error.length()>0) {
      if(error.length()>110)error=error.substring(0,110);
      Serial.printf("Sheets %s rejected: %s\n",action,error.c_str());
      startupLogAdd(String("Sheets ")+action+" rejected: "+error);
      return;
    }
  }
  Serial.printf("Sheets %s: invalid/unexpected JSON payload\n",action);
  startupLogAdd(String("Sheets ")+action+": invalid/unexpected JSON payload");
}

// Lightweight independent Config endpoint: fetched every successful boot,
// even when the roster/recipe UpdateDataNow flag is No. This is only a new
// API action; the proven HTTP retry, token and startup-log transport stays.
static bool validateTimezoneName(const String &value) {
  if(value.isEmpty() || value.length()>64)return false;
  for(size_t i=0;i<value.length();i++) {
    const char c=value[i];
    if(!((c>='a'&&c<='z')||(c>='A'&&c<='Z')||
         (c>='0'&&c<='9')||c=='+'||c=='-'||c==','||
         c==':'||c=='.'||c=='/'||c=='_'||c=='<'||c=='>'))return false;
  }
  return true;
}
bool applyRuntimeConfigPayload(const String &payload,bool persist) {
  DynamicJsonDocument doc(6000);
  if(payload.length()==0 || payload.length()>5500 || deserializeJson(doc,payload)) {
    startupLogAdd("CONFIG rejected: bad JSON or oversized reply");return false;
  }
  if(!(doc["success"]|false)) {
    startupLogAdd("CONFIG rejected: success flag missing");return false;
  }
  JsonObjectConst c=doc["config"].as<JsonObjectConst>();
  if(c.isNull()) {startupLogAdd("CONFIG rejected: missing config");return false;}
  String open=String((const char*)(c["storeOpenTime"]|""));
  String close=String((const char*)(c["storeCloseTime"]|""));
  String mode=String((const char*)(c["deviceMode"]|""));
  String timezone=String((const char*)(c["timezone"]|TZ_INFO));
  open.trim();close.trim();mode.trim();mode.toUpperCase();timezone.trim();
  const int inactivity=c["inactivitySeconds"]|-1;
  const int openMinute=parseStoreClockMinute(open);
  const int closeMinute=parseStoreClockMinute(close);
  if(open.length()>16 || close.length()>16 || openMinute<0 || closeMinute<0 ||
     openMinute==closeMinute ||
     (openMinute+1440-PREOPEN_LEAD_MINUTES)%1440==closeMinute ||
     inactivity<1 || inactivity>180 ||
     (mode!="TEST" && mode!="PRODUCTION") || !validateTimezoneName(timezone)) {
    startupLogAdd("CONFIG rejected: invalid hours, timeout, mode or timezone");
    return false;
  }
  if(persist) {
    // Flash is written only if a value changed. Last good Config remains
    // available when the network is down on the next boot.
    if(prefs.getString("cfg_json","")!=payload &&
       prefs.putString("cfg_json",payload)!=payload.length())
      startupLogAdd("WARNING: Config NVS backup write failed");
    if(prefs.getString("cfg_tz",TZ_INFO)!=timezone)
      prefs.putString("cfg_tz",timezone);
  }
  const bool newTestMode=(mode=="TEST");
  if(deviceTestMode!=newTestMode) prefs.putBool("dev_test",newTestMode);
  deviceTestMode=newTestMode;
  storeOpenTime=open;storeCloseTime=close;
  configuredOpenMinute=openMinute;configuredCloseMinute=closeMinute;
  idleTimeoutMs=(uint32_t)inactivity*1000UL;
  if(configuredTimezone!=timezone) {
    configuredTimezone=timezone;
    setenv("TZ",configuredTimezone.c_str(),1);tzset();
  }
  runtimeConfigLoaded=true;
  if(deviceTestMode) {
    // A previously closed Production boot must visibly wake when Test is
    // loaded, without waiting for a roster download or for the next reboot.
    storeClosedMode=false;scheduledPreopenBoot=false;
    prefs.putBool("closed_mode",false);prefs.putBool("preboot",false);
    stopClosedHeartbeat();digitalWrite(FREENOVE_BACKLIGHT_PIN,HIGH);
  }
  startupLogAdd("Config: mode="+mode+" open="+open+" close="+close+
                " inactivity="+String(inactivity)+"s TZ="+timezone);
  Serial.printf("Config active: %s | %s-%s | idle=%ds | TZ=%s\n",
       mode.c_str(),open.c_str(),close.c_str(),inactivity,timezone.c_str());
  return true;
}
bool loadStoredRuntimeConfig() {
  const String saved=prefs.getString("cfg_json","");
  if(saved.isEmpty())return false;
  const bool valid=applyRuntimeConfigPayload(saved,false);
  startupLogAdd(String("Stored Config: ")+(valid?"RESTORED":"INVALID"));
  return valid;
}
bool refreshConfigAtStartup() {
  startupMessage("REFRESHING CONFIG","Every startup","Independent of data flag");
  String payload;
  if(!sheetGet("config",payload)) {
    startupLogAdd("Config refresh FAILED: using saved values");
    return false;
  }
  if(!applyRuntimeConfigPayload(payload,true)) {
    sheetReportAppError("config",payload);
    startupLogAdd("Config refresh INVALID: using saved values");
    return false;
  }
  startupLogAdd("Config refresh: SUCCESS; latest server settings applied");
  return true;
}

bool checkAndRefreshSheetData() {
  if(sheetAPIToken.length()==0) {
    startupMessage("SHEETS NOT CONFIGURED","Saved data only","No API token stored");
    Serial.println("Sheets integration skipped: no private API token in NVS");
    return false;
  }
  startupMessage("CHECKING DATA FLAG","UpdateDataNow","Reading Config flag only");
  String flagReply;
  if(!sheetGet("flag",flagReply)) {
    startupMessage("FLAG CHECK FAILED","Using local cache","No data downloaded");
    return false;
  }
  DynamicJsonDocument flagDoc(1024);
  if(deserializeJson(flagDoc,flagReply) || !(flagDoc["success"]|false)) {
    sheetReportAppError("flag",flagReply);
    startupMessage("INVALID FLAG","Using local cache","No data downloaded");
    return false;
  }
  // Exact Break Log API pattern: success=true + update="YES" or "NO".
  String updateFlag=String((const char*)(flagDoc["update"] | ""));
  updateFlag.trim();updateFlag.toUpperCase();
  if(updateFlag!="YES" && updateFlag!="NO") {
    Serial.println("Sheets flag invalid: expected update=YES or NO");
    startupMessage("INVALID FLAG","Using local cache","No data downloaded");
    return false;
  }
  Serial.printf("Sheets FLAG: update=%s HTTP=%d\n",updateFlag.c_str(),sheetLastHTTPStatus);
  startupLogAdd("UpdateDataNow: " + updateFlag);
  bool updateNow=(updateFlag=="YES");
  if(!updateNow) {
    startupMessage("DATA CURRENT","UpdateDataNow = No","No download required");
    Serial.println("UpdateDataNow=No: skipped config/roster/recipe download");
    startupLogAdd("Sheet data download: SKIPPED because UpdateDataNow=No");
    return true;
  }
  startupMessage("DATA UPDATE = YES","Downloading sheets","Cook roster and active recipes");
  String payload;
  if(!sheetGet("data",payload)) {
    startupMessage("DATA DOWNLOAD FAILED","Using old cache","Flag stays Yes");
    return false;
  }
  if(!parseSheetDataset(payload,false)) {
    sheetReportAppError("data",payload);
    startupLogAdd("DATA JSON rejected by device validation; flag remains Yes; old cache preserved");
    startupMessage("DATA VALIDATION FAIL","Using old cache","Flag stays Yes");
    return false;
  }
  if(!saveSheetDataAtomic(payload)) {
    startupLogAdd(String("DATA SAVE FAILED; LittleFS ready=")+(fsReady?"YES":"NO")+
                  "; local cache preserved; flag remains Yes");
    startupMessage("DATA SAVE FAILED","Using old cache","Flag stays Yes");
    return false;
  }
  // Cache has been durably saved. Only now activate it and ACK Google.
  if(!parseSheetDataset(payload,true)) {
    startupMessage("DATA ACTIVATE FAILED","Reboot to restore cache","Flag stays Yes");
    return false;
  }
  dataRefreshSucceeded=true;
  String ack;
  if(!sheetGet("ack",ack)) {
    startupMessage("DATA SAVED","Could not clear flag","Will retry next startup");
    return true;
  }
  DynamicJsonDocument ackDoc(1024);
  if(deserializeJson(ackDoc,ack) || !(ackDoc["success"]|false)) {
    sheetReportAppError("ack",ack);
    startupMessage("DATA SAVED","Flag ACK not confirmed","Will retry next startup");
    return true;
  }
  String ackUpdate=String((const char*)(ackDoc["update"] | ""));
  ackUpdate.trim();ackUpdate.toUpperCase();
  if(ackUpdate!="NO") {
    Serial.println("Sheets ACK invalid: expected update=NO");
    startupMessage("DATA SAVED","Flag ACK not confirmed","Will retry next startup");
    return true;
  }
  startupMessage("DATA REFRESHED",String(COOK_COUNT)+" cooks / "+String(RECIPE_COUNT)+" recipes","UpdateDataNow -> No");
  Serial.printf("Downloaded and saved cooks=%d activeRecipes=%d\n",COOK_COUNT,RECIPE_COUNT);
  startupLogAdd("Sheet data committed and ACK confirmed | cooks="+String(COOK_COUNT)+
                " recipes="+String(RECIPE_COUNT));
  return true;
}

// ---------------------- STARTUP LOG (BREAK LOG APPROACH) ----------
// One report per boot.  Only after a matching Google acknowledgement may
// we delete its local file.  A failed roster download must not block logging.
// No SSID passwords, API keys, or URL query strings are written to the log.
static const char* DIAG_ACTIVE_FILE="/cool_startup_active.txt";
static constexpr int DIAG_PENDING_SLOTS=8;
static constexpr size_t DIAG_MAX_CHARS=8500;
static String diagID;
static String diagText;
static uint32_t diagStartedMs=0;
static bool diagStarted=false;
static bool diagFileWritable=false;

String diagPendingPath(int slot) {
  return "/cool_startup_pending_"+String(slot)+".txt";
}
String diagRead(const String& path) {
  if(!fsReady || !LittleFS.exists(path.c_str()))return "";
  fs::File f=LittleFS.open(path.c_str(),"r");
  if(!f)return "";
  if(f.size()>DIAG_MAX_CHARS+512) {f.close();return "";}
  String content=f.readString();f.close();return content;
}
String diagExtractID(const String& report) {
  int p=report.indexOf("StartupID: ");
  if(p<0)return "";
  p+=11;
  int e=report.indexOf('\n',p);
  if(e<0)e=report.length();
  String id=report.substring(p,e);id.trim();return id;
}
void startupLogAdd(const String& line) {
  if(!diagStarted)return;
  if(diagText.length()+line.length()+1>DIAG_MAX_CHARS) {
    if(diagText.indexOf("[LOG TRUNCATED]")<0)
      diagText += "[LOG TRUNCATED]\n";
    return;
  }
  diagText+=line+"\n";
  if(fsReady && diagFileWritable) {
    fs::File f=LittleFS.open(DIAG_ACTIVE_FILE,"a");
    if(f){f.println(line);f.close();}
    else {diagFileWritable=false;Serial.println("Startup diagnostic LittleFS append failed");}
  }
}
void startupLogBegin() {
  diagStartedMs=millis();
  uint64_t mac=ESP.getEfuseMac();
  char buf[58];
  snprintf(buf,sizeof(buf),"CA-%08lX%04X-%08lX",(unsigned long)(uint32_t)mac,
           (unsigned int)((mac>>32)&0xFFFF), (unsigned long)esp_random());
  diagID=String(buf);
  diagStarted=true;
  diagText="";
  diagFileWritable=false;
  // If the previous boot reset during startup or before the log reached Google,
  // move that unfinished report into a distinct pending slot without overwriting.
  if(fsReady) {
    bool safeToCreate=true;
    if(LittleFS.exists(DIAG_ACTIVE_FILE)) {
      safeToCreate=false;
      for(int i=0;i<DIAG_PENDING_SLOTS;i++) {
        String path=diagPendingPath(i);
        if(!LittleFS.exists(path.c_str())) {
          if(LittleFS.rename(DIAG_ACTIVE_FILE,path.c_str()))safeToCreate=true;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    if(safeToCreate) {
      fs::File f=LittleFS.open(DIAG_ACTIVE_FILE,"w");
      if(f){f.close();diagFileWritable=true;}
    } else Serial.println("Startup log queue full: preserving prior active file");
  }
  startupLogAdd("StartupID: " + diagID);
  startupLogAdd("Firmware: " + String(FIRMWARE_VERSION));
  startupLogAdd("Reset Reason Code: " + String((int)esp_reset_reason()));
  startupLogAdd("Free Heap at Boot: " + String((unsigned int)ESP.getFreeHeap()));
  startupLogAdd(String("LittleFS: ") + (fsReady?"OK":"UNAVAILABLE"));
}
// Exact Break Log transport: send POST without redirect following, then
// close it and use a separate GET to the Google ContentService redirect.
// Retry once; do not repeat a successful server write on acknowledgement loss
// without StartupID deduplication (the Apps Script performs that check).
bool diagPOSTOnce(const String& body, String& reply, String& failure) {
  reply="";failure="";
  if(WiFi.status()!=WL_CONNECTED){failure="NO WIFI";return false;}
  String redirect;
  {
    WiFiClientSecure client;client.setInsecure();client.setTimeout(20000);
    HTTPClient http;
    http.setConnectTimeout(20000);http.setTimeout(20000);
    const char* headers[]={"Location"};http.collectHeaders(headers,1);
    if(!http.begin(client,GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL)){failure="POST BEGIN FAILED";return false;}
    http.addHeader("Content-Type","application/json");
    int status=http.POST(body);
    if(status==HTTP_CODE_OK) {
      reply=http.getString();http.end();
      String trimmed=reply;trimmed.trim();
      if(!trimmed.startsWith("{")){failure="POST HTTP200 NON-JSON";return false;}
      return true;
    }
    if(status!=301 && status!=302 && status!=303 && status!=307 && status!=308) {
      failure="POST HTTP="+String(status);http.end();return false;
    }
    redirect=http.header("Location");http.end();
  }
  // Never log redirect URL: it can contain single-use Google query tokens.
  if(!redirect.startsWith("https://script.googleusercontent.com/")) {
    failure="POST REDIRECT HOST UNEXPECTED";return false;
  }
  WiFiClientSecure client;client.setInsecure();client.setTimeout(20000);
  HTTPClient http;
  http.setFollowRedirects(HTTPC_STRICT_FOLLOW_REDIRECTS);
  http.setConnectTimeout(20000);http.setTimeout(20000);
  if(!http.begin(client,redirect)){failure="REDIRECT BEGIN FAILED";return false;}
  int status=http.GET();
  if(status!=HTTP_CODE_OK){failure="REDIRECT HTTP="+String(status);http.end();return false;}
  reply=http.getString();http.end();
  String trimmed=reply;trimmed.trim();
  if(!trimmed.startsWith("{")){failure="REDIRECT NON-JSON";return false;}
  return true;
}
bool diagUpload(const String& report, const String& id, String& error) {
  if(WiFi.status()!=WL_CONNECTED){error="NO WIFI";return false;}
  if(sheetAPIToken.length()==0){error="NO SHEETS TOKEN";return false;}
  DynamicJsonDocument bodyDoc(14000);
  bodyDoc["action"]="logStartup";
  bodyDoc["token"]=sheetAPIToken;
  bodyDoc["item"]="Device Startup";
  bodyDoc["details"]=report;
  bodyDoc["startupID"]=id;
  if(bodyDoc.overflowed()){error="LOG JSON TOO LARGE";return false;}
  String body;serializeJson(bodyDoc,body);
  for(int attempt=1;attempt<=2;attempt++) {
    String reply;
    if(diagPOSTOnce(body,reply,error)) {
      DynamicJsonDocument response(1024);
      if(!deserializeJson(response,reply)) {
        if((response["success"]|false) &&
           String((const char*)(response["startupID"]|""))==id) {
          error="";return true;
        }
        String serverError=String((const char*)(response["error"]|""));
        error=serverError.length()?serverError:"LOG ACK MISMATCH";
      } else error="LOG RESPONSE JSON INVALID";
    }
    if(attempt==1)delay(500);
  }
  return false;
}
void uploadPendingStartupLogs() {
  if(!fsReady || WiFi.status()!=WL_CONNECTED)return;
  for(int i=0;i<DIAG_PENDING_SLOTS;i++) {
    String path=diagPendingPath(i);
    if(!LittleFS.exists(path.c_str()))continue;
    String report=diagRead(path);
    String id=diagExtractID(report);
    if(report.isEmpty() || id.isEmpty()) {
      startupLogAdd("Pending diagnostic invalid in slot "+String(i)+"; preserved");
      continue;
    }
    String error;
    if(diagUpload(report,id,error)) {
      LittleFS.remove(path.c_str());
      startupLogAdd("Pending diagnostic uploaded: "+id);
    } else startupLogAdd("Pending diagnostic upload failed: "+id+" | "+error);
  }
}
void startupLogFinalize(bool online) {
  if(!diagStarted)return;
  startupLogAdd("Clock: "+String(timeSynced?"NTP VERIFIED":"UNVERIFIED"));
  startupLogAdd("Startup RSSI: "+String(startupRSSIValid?String(startupRSSI)+" dBm":"OFF"));
  startupLogAdd("Loaded Cooks: "+String(COOK_COUNT));
  startupLogAdd("Loaded Active Recipes: "+String(RECIPE_COUNT));
  startupLogAdd("Local Alarm Count: "+String(alarmCount));
  startupLogAdd("Data Refresh Saved: "+String(dataRefreshSucceeded?"YES":"NO"));
  startupLogAdd("Device Mode: "+String(deviceTestMode?"Test":"Production"));
  startupLogAdd("Total Startup Duration Ms: "+String(millis()-diagStartedMs));
  startupLogAdd("Free Heap at End: "+String((unsigned int)ESP.getFreeHeap()));
  startupLogAdd("Result: "+String(!online?"OFFLINE":COOK_COUNT==0?"WARNING EMPTY COOK ROSTER":"STARTUP COMPLETE"));
  startupLogAdd("Radio shutdown: scheduled immediately after diagnostic upload");
  String error;
  bool ok=online && diagUpload(diagText,diagID,error);
  if(ok) {
    if(fsReady && diagFileWritable)LittleFS.remove(DIAG_ACTIVE_FILE);
    Serial.println("Startup diagnostic: uploaded and ACK verified");
  } else {
    Serial.printf("Startup diagnostic pending: %s\n",online?error.c_str():"OFFLINE");
    // Leave active LittleFS report untouched for recovery next successful boot.
  }
  diagStarted=false;
}


// ---------------------- DAILY STORE LIFECYCLE ---------------------
// Check store hours once per minute. No network access in the main loop.
// Closed hours span Store Close through 3 hours before Store Open.
// Store Open itself is still sampled every minute, but the screen is already
// enabled after the pre-opening restart for cooks who arrive early.
static uint32_t localDateKey(const struct tm &t) {
  return (uint32_t)(t.tm_year+1900)*10000UL+
         (uint32_t)(t.tm_mon+1)*100UL+(uint32_t)t.tm_mday;
}
static bool localNow(struct tm& t) {
  if(!timeSynced)return false; // demo time cannot delete real alarms
  time_t epoch=time(nullptr);
  return localtime_r(&epoch,&t)!=nullptr && (t.tm_year+1900)>=2025;
}
static int preopeningMinute() {
  return configuredOpenMinute<0?-1:
    (configuredOpenMinute+1440-PREOPEN_LEAD_MINUTES)%1440;
}
static bool closedScheduleAt(int minuteOfDay) {
  if(configuredCloseMinute<0 || preopeningMinute()<0)return false;
  const int preopen=preopeningMinute();
  if(configuredCloseMinute>preopen)
    return minuteOfDay>=configuredCloseMinute || minuteOfDay<preopen;
  return minuteOfDay>=configuredCloseMinute && minuteOfDay<preopen;
}
static uint32_t closeCycleDay(const struct tm& now,int minuteOfDay) {
  // An overnight 10:30PM -> 5AM closing cycle belongs to yesterday
  // during its after-midnight portion. Use mktime for DST-safe date math.
  struct tm closingDay=now;
  if(configuredCloseMinute>preopeningMinute() &&
     minuteOfDay<preopeningMinute()) {
    closingDay.tm_mday-=1;
    closingDay.tm_hour=12;
    closingDay.tm_min=0;closingDay.tm_sec=0;
    mktime(&closingDay);
  }
  return localDateKey(closingDay);
}
void stopClosedHeartbeat() {
  closedHeartbeatOn=false;
  applySignalOutputs();
}
void enterClosedDisplayMode() {
  setAlert(false);
  outputs(false);
  storeClosedMode=true;
  heartbeatAtMs=millis();
  stopClosedHeartbeat();
  digitalWrite(FREENOVE_BACKLIGHT_PIN,LOW); // BL off, ESP32 + LCD controller still powered
}
void performStoreClosing(uint32_t cycleDay) {
  // Disable alarms FIRST, before placing the device in closed mode.
  outputs(false);alertOn=false;
  memset(alarms,0,(MAX_ALARMS*sizeof(Alarm)));
  alarmCount=0;nextId=1;nextPairId=1;
  selectedAlarm=-1;dueAlarm=-1;
  navDepth=0;screen=HOME;
  // Remove the persistent blob, verifying that an empty snapshot was
  // really stored if NVS removal failed. Never silently report success when
  // storage cannot confirm deletion; retry on the next 60-second check.
  if(!prefs.remove("alarms_v109")) {
    Serial.println("Close: NVS erase failed; writing empty alarm snapshot");
    saveLocalAlarms();
  }
  bool storageCleared=(prefs.getBytesLength("alarms_v109")==0);
  if(!storageCleared && prefs.getBytesLength("alarms_v109")==sizeof(AlarmSnapshot)) {
    AlarmSnapshot &verify = *sharedAlarmSnapshot;
    if(prefs.getBytes("alarms_v109",&verify,sizeof(verify))==sizeof(verify))
      storageCleared=verify.magic==ALARM_STORE_MAGIC && verify.format==1 &&
                     verify.count==0 && verify.hash==alarmHash(verify);
  }
  if(storageCleared) {
    prefs.putUInt("closed_day",cycleDay);
    Serial.printf("Store closed for cycle %lu: ALL alarms deleted; LCD OFF\n",
                  (unsigned long)cycleDay);
  } else Serial.println("CRITICAL: Alarm deletion not confirmed in NVS; retry next minute");
  prefs.putBool("closed_mode",true);
  enterClosedDisplayMode();
}
void finishPreopeningStartup() {
  prefs.putBool("closed_mode",false);
  prefs.putBool("preboot",false);
  scheduledPreopenBoot=false;
  storeClosedMode=false;
  stopClosedHeartbeat();
  digitalWrite(FREENOVE_BACKLIGHT_PIN,HIGH);
  Serial.println("Pre-opening restart complete: LCD ON / HOME ready");
}
void serviceStoreSchedule() {
  // Test mode runs continuously: no close-time deletion, no backlight off,
  // no closed-hours lockout, and no scheduled pre-opening restart.
  if(deviceTestMode)return;
  struct tm local={};
  if(!localNow(local) || configuredOpenMinute<0 || configuredCloseMinute<0)return;
  const int minute=local.tm_hour*60+local.tm_min;
  const uint32_t today=localDateKey(local);
  if(closedScheduleAt(minute)) {
    const uint32_t cycle=closeCycleDay(local,minute);
    // Once per closing cycle, including recovery after unexpected power loss.
    if(prefs.getUInt("closed_day",0)!=cycle)performStoreClosing(cycle);
    else if(!storeClosedMode)enterClosedDisplayMode();
    return;
  }
  if(storeClosedMode) {
    // A device that remained running through the night must restart once,
    // within the first 10 minutes of the pre-opening period. A device
    // freshly powered on later does not need an unnecessary second reboot.
    const int preopen=preopeningMinute();
    const int elapsed=(minute+1440-preopen)%1440;
    if(elapsed<10 && prefs.getUInt("preopen_day",0)!=today) {
      prefs.putUInt("preopen_day",today);
      prefs.putBool("preboot",true);
      stopClosedHeartbeat();
      Serial.println("Scheduled pre-opening restart for OTA-first boot");
      Serial.flush();
      ESP.restart();
      return;
    }
    // Reopening fallback (for delayed reboot or power-on after 5:10AM).
    finishPreopeningStartup();
    goHome();
  }
  // Official Store Open Time is checked here too; no further LCD change
  // is required because the screen became available at pre-opening startup.
}
void serviceClosedHeartbeat() {
  if(!storeClosedMode || (!ENABLE_EXT_LED && !ENABLE_ONBOARD_RED_LED))return;
  const uint32_t now=millis();
  if(closedHeartbeatOn) {
    if((uint32_t)(now-heartbeatOnAtMs)>=CLOSED_LED_FLASH_MS) {
      closedHeartbeatOn=false;
      applySignalOutputs();
    }
  } else if((uint32_t)(now-heartbeatAtMs)>=CLOSED_LED_PERIOD_MS) {
    heartbeatAtMs=now;
    heartbeatOnAtMs=now;
    closedHeartbeatOn=true;
    applySignalOutputs();
  }
}


// ---------------------- FREENOVE LVGL HARDWARE LAYER ----------------
// Do not call Display::init(): its default direction and touch mapping differ
// from the ALREADY TESTED 480x320 custom Freenove LVGL configuration.
// Reuse the global TFT_eSPI tft declared by Freenove's original display.cpp.
static void freenoveFlush(lv_disp_drv_t *drv,const lv_area_t *a,lv_color_t *px) {
  const uint32_t w=(uint32_t)(a->x2-a->x1+1);
  const uint32_t h=(uint32_t)(a->y2-a->y1+1);
  tft.startWrite();
  tft.setAddrWindow(a->x1,a->y1,w,h);
  tft.pushColors((uint16_t *)&px->full,w*h,true);
  tft.endWrite();
  lv_disp_flush_ready(drv);
}
static void freenoveTouch(lv_indev_drv_t *drv,lv_indev_data_t *data) {
  (void)drv;
  static uint16_t previousX=0,previousY=0;
  uint16_t x=0,y=0;
  const bool pressed=tft.getTouch(&x,&y,600);
  if(pressed) {
    previousX=constrain((int)x,0,(int)PANEL_W-1);
    previousY=constrain((int)y,0,(int)PANEL_H-1);
    lastActivity=millis();
  }
  data->state=pressed?LV_INDEV_STATE_PR:LV_INDEV_STATE_REL;
  data->point.x=previousX;
  data->point.y=previousY;
}
static void touchOverlayEvent(lv_event_t *e) {
  if(lv_event_get_code(e)!=LV_EVENT_CLICKED || storeClosedMode)return;
  static uint32_t previousTap=0;
  uint32_t now=millis();
  if((uint32_t)(now-previousTap)<120)return;
  previousTap=now;
  lv_indev_t *input=lv_indev_get_act();
  if(!input)return;
  lv_point_t pos;
  lv_indev_get_point(input,&pos);
  const int px=pos.x-LV_VIEW_LEFT,py=pos.y-LV_VIEW_TOP;
  if(px<0 || py<0 || px>=LV_VIEW_W || py>=LV_VIEW_H)return;
  const int scaledX=constrain(px*SW/(int)PANEL_W,0,SW-1);
  const int scaledY=constrain(py*SH/(int)PANEL_H,0,SH-1);
  if(screen==CALIBRATE_TARGETS) {
    processCalibrationPoint(scaledX,scaledY);
  } else {
    int x=0,y=0;
    const Calibration &active=(screen==CALIBRATE_VERIFY)?candidateCal:cal;
    if(mapRawPoint(scaledX,scaledY,active,x,y))onTap(x,y);
  }
}
static lv_color_t from565(uint16_t c) {
  return lv_color_make(((c>>11)&31)*255/31,((c>>5)&63)*255/63,(c&31)*255/31);
}
static void pumpLVGL() {
  if(!lvReady || lvInsideHandler)return;
  lvInsideHandler=true;
#if !LV_TICK_CUSTOM
  uint32_t current=millis();
  uint32_t elapsed=current-lvTickAtMs;
  if(elapsed){lv_tick_inc(elapsed);lvTickAtMs=current;}
#endif
  lv_timer_handler();
  lvInsideHandler=false;
}
static void initFreenoveLVGL() {
  // This exact driver configuration passed touchscreen and LED testing.
  tft.init();
  tft.setRotation(1); // FNK0114S ST7796 => 480x320 landscape
  uint16_t touchCalibration[5]={303,3458,350,3304,7};
  tft.setTouch(touchCalibration);
  lv_init();
  lv_disp_draw_buf_init(&lvDrawBuffer,lvDrawPixels,nullptr,PANEL_W*LVGL_DRAW_LINES);
  static lv_disp_drv_t disp;
  lv_disp_drv_init(&disp);
  disp.hor_res=PANEL_W; disp.ver_res=PANEL_H;
  disp.flush_cb=freenoveFlush;disp.draw_buf=&lvDrawBuffer;
  lv_disp_drv_register(&disp);
  static lv_indev_drv_t indev;
  lv_indev_drv_init(&indev);
  indev.type=LV_INDEV_TYPE_POINTER;indev.read_cb=freenoveTouch;
  lv_indev_drv_register(&indev);
  lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(lv_scr_act(),lv_color_black(),0);
  lv_obj_set_style_bg_opa(lv_scr_act(),LV_OPA_COVER,0);
  nativeRoot=lv_obj_create(lv_scr_act());
  lv_obj_set_pos(nativeRoot,0,0);
  lv_obj_set_size(nativeRoot,PANEL_W,PANEL_H);
  lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(nativeRoot,nativeColor(NAVY),0);
  lv_obj_set_style_bg_opa(nativeRoot,LV_OPA_COVER,0);
  lv_obj_set_style_border_width(nativeRoot,0,0);
  lv_obj_set_style_radius(nativeRoot,0,0);
  lv_obj_set_style_pad_all(nativeRoot,0,0);
  lv_obj_clear_flag(nativeRoot,LV_OBJ_FLAG_SCROLLABLE);
  lv_obj_clear_flag(nativeRoot,LV_OBJ_FLAG_CLICKABLE);
  lvTouchOverlay=lv_obj_create(lv_scr_act());
  lv_obj_set_pos(lvTouchOverlay,0,0);
  lv_obj_set_size(lvTouchOverlay,PANEL_W,PANEL_H);
  lv_obj_set_style_bg_opa(lvTouchOverlay,LV_OPA_TRANSP,0);
  lv_obj_set_style_border_width(lvTouchOverlay,0,0);
  lv_obj_set_style_radius(lvTouchOverlay,0,0);
  lv_obj_set_style_pad_all(lvTouchOverlay,0,0);
  lv_obj_clear_flag(lvTouchOverlay,LV_OBJ_FLAG_SCROLLABLE);
  lv_obj_add_flag(lvTouchOverlay,LV_OBJ_FLAG_CLICKABLE);
  lv_obj_add_event_cb(lvTouchOverlay,touchOverlayEvent,LV_EVENT_CLICKED,nullptr);
  lvTickAtMs=millis();lvReady=true;
  Serial.printf("[LVGL] NATIVE widgets 480x320; no 4-bit canvas; free=%u largestInternal=%u\n",
      (unsigned)ESP.getFreeHeap(),
      (unsigned)heap_caps_get_largest_free_block(MALLOC_CAP_INTERNAL|MALLOC_CAP_8BIT));
  bootLogScreenInit();
  bootLogShow(true);
}

// ================= STARTUP SERIAL MONITOR MIRROR =================
// Keep the most recent complete lines so the screen can scroll naturally.
// Fixed buffers avoid unbounded String growth during HTTPS/OTA startup.
static constexpr uint8_t BOOT_LOG_LINES=14;
static constexpr size_t BOOT_LOG_LINE_CHARS=128;
// Heap allocation keeps the startup console's ~5 KB out of .dram0.bss.
// The earlier fixed arrays caused a 1,840-byte ESP32 DRAM linker overflow.
static char (*bootLogRing)[BOOT_LOG_LINE_CHARS]=nullptr;
static constexpr size_t BOOT_LOG_TEXT_CAPACITY=2600;
static char* bootLogText=nullptr;
// These assertions fail at compile time if someone restores static log arrays.
static_assert(sizeof(bootLogRing)==sizeof(void*), "startup ring must be a pointer");
static_assert(sizeof(bootLogText)==sizeof(void*), "startup screen text must be a pointer");
static uint8_t bootLogFirst=0,bootLogUsed=0;
static char bootCurrentLine[BOOT_LOG_LINE_CHARS]={0};
static size_t bootCurrentSize=0;
static bool bootLogDirty=true;
static bool bootLogActive=false;
static bool bootLogRendering=false;
static uint32_t bootLogLastPaint=0;
// One LVGL label per visible console row. Avoid invalidating the entire
// 480x320 screen whenever another serial message arrives.
static lv_obj_t* bootLogScroll=nullptr;
static lv_obj_t* bootLogRows[BOOT_LOG_LINES]={nullptr};
static constexpr lv_coord_t BOOT_LOG_ROW_HEIGHT=22;

static bool bootLogInitBuffers() {
  if(bootLogRing && bootLogText)return true;
  bootLogRing=(char (*)[BOOT_LOG_LINE_CHARS])malloc(
      BOOT_LOG_LINES*BOOT_LOG_LINE_CHARS);
  bootLogText=(char*)malloc(BOOT_LOG_TEXT_CAPACITY);
  if(!bootLogRing || !bootLogText) {
    free(bootLogRing);free(bootLogText);
    bootLogRing=nullptr;bootLogText=nullptr;
    startupSerial.mirroring=false; // Serial remains available for diagnostics.
    return false;
  }
  memset(bootLogRing,0,BOOT_LOG_LINES*BOOT_LOG_LINE_CHARS);
  bootLogText[0]=0;
  return true;
}

static void bootLogStoreLine() {
  // Overwrite only the oldest visible line when the ring is full.
  const uint8_t index=(bootLogFirst+bootLogUsed)%BOOT_LOG_LINES;
  if(bootLogUsed==BOOT_LOG_LINES)bootLogFirst=(bootLogFirst+1)%BOOT_LOG_LINES;
  else ++bootLogUsed;
  memcpy(bootLogRing[index],bootCurrentLine,bootCurrentSize);
  bootLogRing[index][bootCurrentSize]=0;
  bootCurrentSize=0;
  bootCurrentLine[0]=0;
  bootLogDirty=true;
}
static void bootLogCapture(const uint8_t* bytes,size_t count) {
  for(size_t i=0;i<count;i++) {
    const char ch=(char)bytes[i];
    if(ch=='\r')continue;
    if(ch=='\n') {
      bootLogStoreLine();
    } else if((uint8_t)ch>=32 || ch=='\t') {
      if(bootCurrentSize<BOOT_LOG_LINE_CHARS-1) {
        bootCurrentLine[bootCurrentSize++]=ch;
        bootCurrentLine[bootCurrentSize]=0;
        // Deliberately DO NOT invalidate the display for each partial line.
        // The complete message is shown on the next newline.
      }
    }
  }
  // Let long HTTP operations continue unblocked: update after complete lines.
  // Once the 18-line viewport fills, group repaints to avoid visible sweeps
  // from 18 labels being shifted for every single Serial.print().
  if(bootLogActive && bootLogDirty &&
      (uint32_t)(millis()-bootLogLastPaint)>350)
    bootLogShow(false);
}
static void bootLogScreenInit() {
  if(!lvReady || !nativeRoot || bootLogActive ||
     !bootLogRing || !bootLogText)return;
  lv_obj_clean(nativeRoot);
  nativeHeaderText=nullptr;nativeDueEdge=nullptr;nativeStartupProgressBar=nullptr;
  lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(nativeRoot,lv_color_black(),0);
  lv_obj_set_style_bg_opa(nativeRoot,LV_OPA_COVER,0);
  lv_obj_set_style_text_font(nativeRoot,&cool_mono_regular_18,0);

  bootLogScroll=lv_obj_create(nativeRoot);
  lv_obj_set_pos(bootLogScroll,0,0);
  lv_obj_set_size(bootLogScroll,PANEL_W,PANEL_H);
  lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(bootLogScroll,lv_color_black(),0);
  lv_obj_set_style_bg_opa(bootLogScroll,LV_OPA_COVER,0);
  lv_obj_set_style_border_width(bootLogScroll,0,0);
  lv_obj_set_style_radius(bootLogScroll,0,0);
  lv_obj_set_style_pad_all(bootLogScroll,0,0);
  lv_obj_clear_flag(bootLogScroll,LV_OBJ_FLAG_SCROLLABLE);
  lv_obj_clear_flag(bootLogScroll,LV_OBJ_FLAG_CLICKABLE);

  // Stable, bounded row objects avoid reflow and scrolling the entire panel.
  // Each new complete Serial line changes just the necessary text widgets.
  for(uint8_t i=0;i<BOOT_LOG_LINES;i++) {
    lv_obj_t* row=lv_label_create(bootLogScroll);
    bootLogRows[i]=row;
    lv_obj_set_pos(row,4,4+(lv_coord_t)i*BOOT_LOG_ROW_HEIGHT);
    lv_obj_set_size(row,PANEL_W-8,BOOT_LOG_ROW_HEIGHT);
    lv_label_set_long_mode(row,LV_LABEL_LONG_DOT); // Never render below 18px.
    lv_obj_set_style_text_color(row,lv_color_make(225,239,234),0);
    lv_obj_set_style_text_align(row,LV_TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT,0);
    lv_obj_set_style_text_font(row,&cool_mono_regular_18,0);
    lv_label_set_text(row,"");
  }
  if(lvTouchOverlay)lv_obj_add_flag(lvTouchOverlay,LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
  bootLogActive=true;
  bootLogDirty=true;
}
static void bootLogShow(bool force) {
  if(!bootLogActive || !lvReady || !bootLogRows[0] ||
     !bootLogRing || !bootLogText ||
     bootLogRendering || lvInsideHandler || !bootLogDirty)return;
  // After the viewport fills, a new line shifts many rows. Batch such
  // updates rather than forcing 18 independent repaints in quick succession.
  if((uint32_t)(millis()-bootLogLastPaint)<
     (bootLogUsed==BOOT_LOG_LINES ? 350UL : (force ? 0UL : 120UL)))return;
  bootLogRendering=true;
  for(uint8_t i=0;i<BOOT_LOG_LINES;i++) {
    const char* line=(i<bootLogUsed)
        ? bootLogRing[(bootLogFirst+i)%BOOT_LOG_LINES] : "";
    // Leave unchanged rows alone: LVGL will only invalidate altered rows.
    if(strcmp(lv_label_get_text(bootLogRows[i]),line)!=0)
      lv_label_set_text(bootLogRows[i],line);
  }
  bootLogDirty=false;
  bootLogLastPaint=millis();
  bootLogRendering=false;
  pumpLVGL();
}
static void bootLogScreenStop() {
  bootLogShow(true);
  bootLogActive=false;
  bootLogScroll=nullptr;
  for(uint8_t i=0;i<BOOT_LOG_LINES;i++)bootLogRows[i]=nullptr;
  if(lvTouchOverlay)lv_obj_clear_flag(lvTouchOverlay,LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
  startupSerial.mirroring=false;
  free(bootLogRing);bootLogRing=nullptr;
  free(bootLogText);bootLogText=nullptr;
}

// ================= NATIVE LVGL UI (FIRST MIGRATION BUILD) =================
// All screen pixels below use LVGL widgets. The original 320x240 action
// rectangles are retained ONLY for behavior routing, scaled to 480x320.
// No 4-bit canvas and no custom framebuffer is allocated.
// These helpers do not perform network calls or alter saved alarm data.
static lv_color_t nativeColor(uint16_t c) {
  return lv_color_make(((c>>11)&31)*255/31,((c>>5)&63)*255/63,(c&31)*255/31);
}
static int nx(int x){return x*PANEL_W/SW;}
static int ny(int y){return y*PANEL_H/SH;}
static int nright(int x){return (x*PANEL_W+SW-1)/SW;}
static int nbottom(int y){return (y*PANEL_H+SH-1)/SH;}
static Rect nbounds(const Rect& r) {
  const int x0=nx(r.x), y0=ny(r.y);
  return {x0,y0,nright(r.x+r.w)-x0,nbottom(r.y+r.h)-y0};
}
static void nbase(bool withHeader=true) {
  if(!nativeRoot)return;
  lv_obj_clean(nativeRoot);
  nativeHeaderText=nullptr;nativeDueEdge=nullptr;nativeStartupProgressBar=nullptr;
  homeDateText=nullptr;homeClockText=nullptr;homeVersionText=nullptr;
  const bool blackApproved=(screen==CREATE_ALARM || screen==EDIT_TIME ||
       screen==RECIPE_OPTIONS || screen==VIEW_RECIPES || screen==CONFIRMATION || (screen==VIEW_ROSTER && (rosterForCreate || rosterForEdit)));
  lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(nativeRoot,blackApproved?lv_color_black():nativeColor(NAVY),0);
  lv_obj_set_style_bg_opa(nativeRoot,LV_OPA_COVER,0);
  lv_obj_set_style_text_font(nativeRoot,&cool_mono_regular_18,0); // Project minimum.
  if(withHeader) {
    // Exact HOME header: date left, time centered, version right.
    // No divider line, title box, or extra decoration on any screen.
    homeDateText=homeLabel("",9,9,126,29,&cool_mono_regular_18,LV_TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT);
    homeClockText=homeLabel("",132,9,217,29,&cool_mono_regular_18,LV_TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER);
    homeVersionText=homeLabel(String(FIRMWARE_VERSION),351,9,120,29,
                              &cool_mono_regular_18,LV_TEXT_ALIGN_RIGHT);
    homeRefreshClockAndDate();
  }
}
static lv_obj_t* ntext(const String& s,Rect logical,uint16_t fg=WHITE,bool centered=false) {
  if(!nativeRoot)return nullptr;
  lv_obj_t* o=lv_label_create(nativeRoot);
  const Rect r=nbounds(logical);
  lv_obj_set_pos(o,r.x,r.y);
  lv_obj_set_size(o,r.w,r.h);
  lv_obj_set_style_text_color(o,nativeColor(fg),0);
  lv_obj_set_style_text_align(o,centered?LV_TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER:LV_TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT,0);
  lv_label_set_long_mode(o,LV_LABEL_LONG_DOT); // Wrap to height, then show ...
  lv_obj_set_style_text_font(o,&cool_mono_regular_18,0);
  lv_label_set_text(o,s.c_str());
  return o;
}
static lv_obj_t* ntile(Rect logical,uint16_t bg,uint16_t border=DIM,int radius=5,bool enabled=true) {
  if(!nativeRoot)return nullptr;
  const Rect r=nbounds(logical);
  lv_obj_t* o=lv_obj_create(nativeRoot);
  lv_obj_set_pos(o,r.x,r.y);lv_obj_set_size(o,r.w,r.h);
  lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(o,nativeColor(bg),0);
  lv_obj_set_style_bg_opa(o,LV_OPA_COVER,0);
  lv_obj_set_style_border_width(o,border?1:0,0);
  lv_obj_set_style_border_color(o,nativeColor(border),0);
  lv_obj_set_style_radius(o,((radius*PANEL_H)/SH),0);
  lv_obj_set_style_pad_all(o,0,0);
  lv_obj_clear_flag(o,LV_OBJ_FLAG_SCROLLABLE);
  lv_obj_clear_flag(o,LV_OBJ_FLAG_CLICKABLE); // the proven touch overlay routes taps
  if(!enabled)lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(o,nativeColor(GREY),0);
  return o;
}
// Shared caption renderer for every button: maximum 20px bold, minimum 18px.
// Fit in one or two centered lines as permitted; long labels show ... (LVGL DOT).
// Keep existing touch targets, button backgrounds, and non-button text unchanged.
static void adaptiveButtonCaption(lv_obj_t* parent,const String& caption,
                                  int x,int y,int w,int h,lv_color_t fg,int maxLines) {
  if(!parent || caption.length()==0)return;
  static const lv_font_t* fonts[]={&cool_mono_bold_20,&cool_mono_regular_18};
  static const int cellPixels[]={13,11};
  w=max(1,w);h=max(1,h);
  maxLines=max(1,min(2,maxLines));
  const int breakPos=caption.indexOf('\n');
  const int chars=(int)homeUtf8Chars(caption);
  const int longestLine=breakPos>=0?
    max((int)homeUtf8Chars(caption.substring(0,breakPos)),
        (int)homeUtf8Chars(caption.substring(breakPos+1))):chars;
  const int minLines=breakPos>=0?2:1;
  const lv_font_t* selected=fonts[1];
  int lines=1;
  bool found=false;
  // Use 20px bold whenever it can fit; step down to 18px only if needed.
  for(int f=0;f<2 && !found;f++) {
    const int columns=w/cellPixels[f];
    if(columns<=0)continue;
    for(int n=minLines;n<=maxLines;n++) {
      if(n*(int)fonts[f]->line_height>h)continue;
      if((breakPos>=0?longestLine<=columns:chars<=columns*n)) {
        selected=fonts[f];lines=n;found=true;break;
      }
    }
  }
  if(!found) {
    // Never drop below 18px. LVGL truncates overflow with an ellipsis.
    lines=max(1,min(maxLines,h/(int)selected->line_height));
  }
  const int labelH=min(h,lines*(int)selected->line_height);
  lv_obj_t* label=lv_label_create(parent);
  lv_obj_set_pos(label,x,y+(h-labelH)/2);
  lv_obj_set_size(label,w,labelH);
  lv_obj_set_style_text_font(label,selected,0);
  lv_obj_set_style_text_color(label,fg,0);
  lv_obj_set_style_text_align(label,LV_TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER,0);
  lv_label_set_long_mode(label,LV_LABEL_LONG_DOT);
  lv_label_set_text(label,caption.c_str());
}
static void nbutton(Rect r,const String& text,uint16_t bg=BLUE,uint16_t fg=WHITE,bool enabled=true) {
  ntile(r,enabled?bg:GREY,enabled?DIM:GREY,5,enabled);
  if(text.length()==0)return;
  const Rect b=nbounds(r);
  adaptiveButtonCaption(nativeRoot,text,b.x+6,b.y+4,max(1,b.w-12),
                        max(1,b.h-8),nativeColor(enabled?fg:DIM),2);
}
static void nline(const String& s,int y,uint16_t c=WHITE,int height=24) {
  ntext(s,{8,y,304,height},c,true);
}
static void ntitle(const String& s,int page=0,int pages=0) {
  ntext(s,{9,29,210,23},WHITE,false);
  if(pages>0)ntext(String(page+1)+"/"+String(pages),{242,29,69,23},TEAL,true);
}
static void nnav(bool prev=true,bool next=true,const char* centerLabel="HOME") {
  nbutton(NAV_HOME,centerLabel,GREEN,WHITE);
  nbutton(NAV_PREV,"PREV",BLUE,WHITE,prev);
  nbutton(NAV_NEXT,"NEXT",BLUE,WHITE,next);
}
// HOME design Draft 2: direct native 480x320 coordinates (no framebuffer).
// Preserve the other screens' current layouts until the HOME template is tested.
static lv_obj_t* homeLabel(const String &value,int x,int y,int w,int h,
                           const lv_font_t* font,lv_text_align_t align,
                           bool wrap) {
  lv_obj_t* label=lv_label_create(nativeRoot);
  lv_obj_set_pos(label,x,y);
  lv_obj_set_size(label,w,h);
  lv_label_set_long_mode(label,wrap?LV_LABEL_LONG_DOT:LV_LABEL_LONG_CLIP);
  lv_obj_set_style_text_color(label,lv_color_white(),0);
  lv_obj_set_style_text_font(label,font,0);
  lv_obj_set_style_text_align(label,align,0);
  lv_obj_set_style_text_letter_space(label,0,0);
  lv_label_set_text(label,value.c_str());
  return label;
}
static uint16_t homeUtf8Chars(const String& s) {
  uint16_t n=0;
  for(size_t i=0;i<s.length();++i)
    if((((uint8_t)s[i])&0xC0)!=0x80)++n;
  return n;
}
static void homeAutoFit(const String& value,int y,int h) {
  // Fonts share the same DejaVu Sans Mono cell width at each size.
  // First select the largest font with an entire single line in 456px.
  static const lv_font_t* choices[] = {
    &cool_mono_bold_32,&cool_mono_bold_28,&cool_mono_bold_24,
    &cool_mono_bold_20,&cool_mono_regular_18
  };
  static const uint8_t cellPixels[] = {20,17,15,13,11};
  const int maxW=456;
  const uint16_t glyphs=homeUtf8Chars(value);
  const lv_font_t* selected=choices[4];
  bool fitsOneLine=false;
  for(int i=0;i<5;i++) {
    if((uint32_t)glyphs*cellPixels[i] <= (uint32_t)maxW) {
      selected=choices[i]; fitsOneLine=true; break;
    }
  }
  const int lines=fitsOneLine?1:2;
  const int lineH=selected->line_height;
  const int actualH=(h<lines*lineH ? h : lines*lineH);
  int top=y+(h-actualH)/2;
  if(top<y)top=y;
  homeLabel(value,12,top,maxW,actualH,selected,LV_TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER,!fitsOneLine);
}
static void uiLargeButton(Rect logical,const String& caption,uint16_t bg,
                          uint16_t border,bool enabled,int maxLines) {
  lv_obj_t* bgTile=ntile(logical,enabled?bg:GREY,enabled?border:GREY,8,enabled);
  (void)bgTile;
  const Rect r=nbounds(logical);
  adaptiveButtonCaption(nativeRoot,caption,r.x+7,r.y+4,max(1,r.w-14),
                        max(1,r.h-9),enabled?lv_color_white():
                        lv_color_make(155,155,155),maxLines);
}
static void homeButton(const Rect& logical,const char* caption,lv_color_t color,bool enabled,
                       lv_color_t textColor) {
  Rect r=nbounds(logical);
  lv_obj_t* btn=lv_obj_create(nativeRoot);
  lv_obj_set_pos(btn,r.x,r.y);
  lv_obj_set_size(btn,r.w,r.h);
  lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(btn,enabled?color:lv_color_make(70,70,70),0);
  lv_obj_set_style_bg_opa(btn,LV_OPA_COVER,0);
  lv_obj_set_style_border_width(btn,0,0);
  lv_obj_set_style_radius(btn,10,0);
  lv_obj_set_style_pad_all(btn,0,0);
  lv_obj_clear_flag(btn,LV_OBJ_FLAG_SCROLLABLE);
  lv_obj_clear_flag(btn,LV_OBJ_FLAG_CLICKABLE); // Existing touch overlay handles taps.
  adaptiveButtonCaption(btn,String(caption),6,4,max(1,r.w-12),max(1,r.h-8),
                        enabled?textColor:lv_color_make(155,155,155),1);
}
static String homeAlarmTime(int minute) {
  const int m=((minute%1440)+1440)%1440;
  return clockHHMM(minute)+((m/60)>=12?" PM":" AM");
}
static String homeCookName(const char* initials) {
  for(int i=0;i<COOK_COUNT;i++)
    if(strcasecmp(cooks[i].initials,initials)==0 && cooks[i].name[0])
      return String(cooks[i].name); // Preserve approved v1.35 HOME behavior.
  return String(initials); // Keep alarm usable if the cook was removed from roster.
}
// Other alarm screens display the cook's first name, as approved for v1.36.
static String alarmFirstCookName(const char* initials) {
  for(int i=0;i<COOK_COUNT;i++)
    if(strcasecmp(cooks[i].initials,initials)==0 && cooks[i].name[0])
      return cookFirstName(i);
  return String(initials);
}
static void homeRefreshClockAndDate() {
  if(homeDateText) {
    String d=currentHeaderDate();d.toUpperCase();
    lv_label_set_text(homeDateText,d.c_str());
  }
  if(homeClockText) {
    const int sec=((nowSeconds()%86400)+86400)%86400;
    const String time=clockHMS()+((sec/3600)>=12?" PM":" AM");
    lv_label_set_text(homeClockText,time.c_str());
  }
}
static void nativeRefreshHeader(){
  homeRefreshClockAndDate(); // same fixed date/time/version header on all eligible screens
}
static void nativeUpdateDueBorder(bool active) {
  if(nativeDueEdge) {
    lv_obj_set_style_border_color(nativeDueEdge,nativeColor(active?RED:NAVY),0);
    lv_obj_set_style_border_width(nativeDueEdge,active?nx(8):0,0);
  }
}
// Startup status screens are replaced by a persistent scrolling log.
static void nativeStartupMessage(const String&,const String&,const String&) {
  bootLogShow(true);
}
static void nativeProgress(int) {
  // OTA progress is reported by the original Serial code. No separate page.
  bootLogShow(false);
}
static void nativeRender(){
  nbase(screen!=HOME && screen!=CALIBRATE_TARGETS && screen!=RECIPE_OPTIONS && screen!=VIEW_RECIPES);
  switch(screen) {
    case HOME: {
      // HOME Draft 2: LCD Wizard design, native LVGL, monospaced typography.
      lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(nativeRoot,lv_color_black(),0);
      homeDateText=homeLabel("",9,9,126,29,&cool_mono_regular_18,LV_TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT);
      homeClockText=homeLabel("",132,9,217,29,&cool_mono_regular_18,LV_TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER);
      homeVersionText=homeLabel(String(FIRMWARE_VERSION),351,9,120,29,
                                &cool_mono_regular_18,LV_TEXT_ALIGN_RIGHT);
      homeRefreshClockAndDate();
      const int idx=nextPending();
      if(idx>=0) {
        const Alarm& a=alarms[idx];
        homeAutoFit(String("c")+String(a.stage)+" "+homeAlarmTime(a.whenMin)+" "+
                    homeCookName(a.initials),53,49);
        homeAutoFit(String(a.recipe),109,49);
      }
      // No pending alarms: keep the two information rows completely blank.
      // The red CREATE ALARMS button remains visible and actionable.
      // The old HOME warned about an unverified clock; preserve that
      // safety warning while using this new, otherwise uncluttered layout.
      if(!timeSynced) {
        lv_obj_t* clockWarn=homeLabel("CLOCK NOT VERIFIED",112,156,256,19,
                                      &cool_mono_bold_16,LV_TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER);
        lv_obj_set_style_text_color(clockWarn,lv_color_make(255,213,40),0);
      }
      // Only visually disable actions that existing touch routing disables.
      homeButton(HOME_DONE,"DONE",lv_color_make(87,199,90),idx>=0);
      homeButton(HOME_CREATE,"CREATE ALARMS",lv_color_make(224,58,43),true);
      homeButton(HOME_ALARMS,"VIEW ALARMS",lv_color_make(82,43,237),countVisibleAlarms()>0);
      homeButton(HOME_SETTINGS,"SETTINGS",lv_color_make(255,214,0),true,lv_color_black());
      break;
    }
    case SETTINGS: {
      ntitle("Settings");
      ntext(String("RSSI: ")+(startupRSSIValid?String(startupRSSI)+" dBm":"OFF"),{170,29,140,23},TEAL,true);
      nbutton(SETTINGS_ROSTER,"View Roster",YELLOW,BLACK);
      nbutton(SETTINGS_RECIPES,"View Recipes",BLUE,WHITE);
      nbutton(SETTINGS_COOLING,"COOLING INFO",SETTINGS_TEAL,WHITE);
      nbutton(SETTINGS_COOKING,"COOKING INFO",UI_PURPLE,WHITE);
      ntile(SETTINGS_BLANK_LEFT,PANEL);ntile(SETTINGS_BLANK_RIGHT,PANEL);
      nbutton(SETTINGS_HOME,"HOME",GREEN,WHITE);
      nbutton(SETTINGS_ADVANCED,"ADVANCED",SETTINGS_ORANGE,BLACK);
      break;
    }
    case ADVANCED_SETTINGS: {
      ntitle("Advanced Settings");
      homeLabel(String("Device Mode: ")+(deviceTestMode?"Test":"Production"),
                213,39,256,29,&cool_mono_regular_18,LV_TEXT_ALIGN_RIGHT,false);
      nbutton(ADV_RESTART,"RESTART",YELLOW,BLACK);
      nbutton(ADV_CLEAR,"CLEAR ALL ALARMS",DARK_RED,WHITE);
      nbutton(ADV_CALIBRATE,"CALIBRATE SCREEN",SETTINGS_TEAL,WHITE);
      ntile(ADV_BLANK1,PANEL);ntile(ADV_BLANK2,PANEL);ntile(ADV_BLANK3,PANEL);
      nbutton(ADV_BACK,"BACK",BLUE,WHITE);
      nbutton(ADV_HOME,"HOME",GREEN,WHITE);
      break;
    }
    case VIEW_ALARMS: {
      sortAlarms();
      const int last=visibleAlarmCount?((visibleAlarmCount-1)/ALARMS_PER_PAGE)*ALARMS_PER_PAGE:0;
      alarmFirst=constrain(alarmAnchor+ALARMS_PER_PAGE*alarmPageOffset,0,last);
      const int pages=max(1,(visibleAlarmCount+ALARMS_PER_PAGE-1)/ALARMS_PER_PAGE);
      const int page=alarmFirst/ALARMS_PER_PAGE;
      // No VIEW ALARMS title; six 2-line cards start immediately below header.
      for(int slot=0;slot<ALARMS_PER_PAGE;slot++) {
        const int p=alarmFirst+slot;
        if(p>=visibleAlarmCount)break;
        const Alarm &a=alarms[sorted[p]];
        const uint16_t bg=a.status==AlarmStatus::Done?GREEN:a.status==AlarmStatus::Pending?(sorted[p]==nextPending()?RED:YELLOW):GREY;
        const uint16_t fg=bg==YELLOW?BLACK:WHITE;
        const Rect card=alarmCardAt(slot);
        ntile(card,bg,sorted[p]==selectedAlarm?TEAL:DIM,4);
        ntext(String("c")+String(a.stage)+" "+homeAlarmTime(a.whenMin)+" "+
              alarmFirstCookName(a.initials),{card.x+4,card.y+3,card.w-8,20},fg);
        ntext(String(a.recipe),{card.x+4,card.y+23,card.w-8,19},fg);
      }
      ntile(LIST_NAV_PAGE,PANEL,0,5);
      ntext(String(page+1)+" / "+String(pages),
            {LIST_NAV_PAGE.x+3,LIST_NAV_PAGE.y+16,LIST_NAV_PAGE.w-6,27},WHITE,true);
      nbutton(LIST_NAV_HOME,"HOME",YELLOW,BLACK);
      nbutton(LIST_NAV_PREV,"PREV",BLUE,WHITE,alarmFirst>0);
      nbutton(LIST_NAV_NEXT,"NEXT",BLUE,WHITE,alarmFirst+ALARMS_PER_PAGE<visibleAlarmCount);
      break;
    }
    case ALARM_DETAILS: {
      if(selectedAlarm<0 || selectedAlarm>=alarmCount) {
        nline("Alarm unavailable",90);nbutton(DETAIL_BACK,"BACK",DARK_RED);break;
      }
      const Alarm& a=alarms[selectedAlarm];
      ntile({8,32,304,45},PANEL);
      homeAutoFit(String("c")+String(a.stage)+" "+homeAlarmTime(a.whenMin)+" "+
                  alarmFirstCookName(a.initials),45,57);
      ntile({8,83,304,40},PANEL);
      homeAutoFit(String(a.recipe),110,53);
      const AlarmStatus st=detailPreviewChanged?detailPreviewStatus:a.status;
      const bool overdue=st==AlarmStatus::Pending && alarmPastDue(a);
      nbutton(DETAIL_STATUS,overdue?"OVERDUE":st==AlarmStatus::Pending?"PENDING":st==AlarmStatus::Done?"DONE":"CANCELLED",
              overdue?DARK_RED:st==AlarmStatus::Done?GREEN:st==AlarmStatus::Cancelled?GREY:BLUE,WHITE,
              a.status!=AlarmStatus::Cancelled);
      nbutton(DETAIL_BACK,"BACK",DARK_RED,WHITE);
      nbutton(DETAIL_EDIT,"EDIT",GREEN,WHITE);
      break;
    }
    case VIEW_ROSTER: {
      if(rosterForCreate || rosterForEdit) {
        const int pages=max(1,(COOK_COUNT+COOK_SELECT_PER_PAGE-1)/COOK_SELECT_PER_PAGE);
        rosterPage=constrain(rosterPage,0,pages-1);
        for(int i=0;i<COOK_SELECT_PER_PAGE;i++) {
          int offset=rosterPage*COOK_SELECT_PER_PAGE+i;
          if(offset>=COOK_COUNT)break;
          int ci=cookSelectOrder[offset];
          uiLargeButton(cookSelectionCard(i),cookFirstName(ci),UI_PURPLE,TEAL,true,2);
        }
        // Small page indicator above the navigation buttons.
        ntext(String(rosterPage+1)+" / "+String(pages),{122,182,76,22},WHITE,true);
        uiLargeButton(COOK_SELECT_BACK,"BACK",DARK_RED,RED,true,1);
        uiLargeButton(COOK_SELECT_PREV,"PREV",UI_DARK_BLUE,TEAL,rosterPage>0,1);
        uiLargeButton(COOK_SELECT_NEXT,"NEXT",UI_DARK_BLUE,TEAL,(rosterPage+1)*COOK_SELECT_PER_PAGE<COOK_COUNT,1);
      } else {
        const int pages=max(1,(COOK_COUNT+ROSTER_PER_PAGE-1)/ROSTER_PER_PAGE);
        rosterPage=constrain(rosterPage,0,pages-1);
        ntitle("View Roster",rosterPage,pages);
        for(int i=0;i<ROSTER_PER_PAGE;i++) {
          const int idx=rosterPage*ROSTER_PER_PAGE+i;
          if(idx>=COOK_COUNT)break;
          const int ci=cookSelectOrder[idx];
          const Rect r=rosterCardAt(i);
          uiLargeButton(r,cookFirstName(ci),PANEL,
                        ci==rosterBrowseSelected?TEAL:GREY,true,2);
        }
        nnav(rosterPage>0,(rosterPage+1)*ROSTER_PER_PAGE<COOK_COUNT);
      }
      break;
    }
    case VIEW_RECIPES: {
      for(int i=0;i<RECIPE_COUNT;i++)recipeOrder[i]=i;
      for(int i=1;i<RECIPE_COUNT;i++) {
        int ri=recipeOrder[i],j=i-1;
        while(j>=0 && strcasecmp(recipes[recipeOrder[j]].name,recipes[ri].name)>0) {
          recipeOrder[j+1]=recipeOrder[j];--j;
        }
        recipeOrder[j+1]=ri;
      }
      const int pages=max(1,(RECIPE_COUNT+RECIPE_REFERENCE_PER_PAGE-1)/RECIPE_REFERENCE_PER_PAGE);
      viewRecipePage=constrain(viewRecipePage,0,pages-1);
      // Match Create Alarm > Choose Recipe: black BG, 2x3 purple/teal cards,
      // no header, large centered names, and PAGE | BACK | PREV | NEXT.
      if(!RECIPE_COUNT)nline("No cached recipes",101,TEAL);
      for(int i=0;i<RECIPE_REFERENCE_PER_PAGE;i++) {
        const int index=viewRecipePage*RECIPE_REFERENCE_PER_PAGE+i;
        if(index>=RECIPE_COUNT)break;
        uiLargeButton(guidedRecipeCard(i),String(recipes[recipeOrder[index]].name),
                      UI_PURPLE,TEAL,true,2);
      }
      uiLargeButton(GUIDED_PAGE,String(viewRecipePage+1)+"/"+String(pages),PANEL,DIM,true,1);
      uiLargeButton(GUIDED_RECIPE_BACK,"BACK",DARK_RED,RED,true,1);
      uiLargeButton(GUIDED_RECIPE_PREV,"PREV",UI_DARK_BLUE,TEAL,viewRecipePage>0,1);
      uiLargeButton(GUIDED_RECIPE_NEXT,"NEXT",UI_DARK_BLUE,TEAL,
                    (viewRecipePage+1)*RECIPE_REFERENCE_PER_PAGE<RECIPE_COUNT,1);
      break;
    }
    case RECIPE_INFO: {
      ntitle("Recipe Information");
      if(viewRecipeSelected>=0 && viewRecipeSelected<RECIPE_COUNT) {
        const RecipeInfo &r=recipes[viewRecipeSelected];
        uiLargeButton({8,52,304,47},String(r.name),PANEL,DIM,true,2);
        ntile({8,106,304,32},PANEL);
        ntext(String("Venue: ")+(r.venue<VENUE_COUNT?String(VENUES[r.venue]):"Unknown"),
              {16,111,288,24},WHITE,false);
        ntile({8,143,304,32},PANEL);
        ntext(String("Type: ")+(r.type<TYPE_COUNT?String(TYPES[r.type]):"Unknown"),
              {16,148,288,24},WHITE,false);
      } else nline("No recipe selected",99,TEAL);
      nbutton(RECIPE_INFO_BACK,"BACK",BLUE,WHITE);
      break;
    }
    case RECIPE_OPTIONS: case CHOOSE_RECIPE: {
      const int count=recipeOptionCount();
      if(optionField==FIELD_RECIPE){
        const int pages=max(1,(count+5)/6);
        recipePage=constrain(recipePage,0,pages-1);
        // No status header: 2 x 3 big tappable recipe names.
        if(!count)nline("No active recipes",101,TEAL);
        for(int i=0;i<6;i++) {
          const int p=recipePage*6+i;if(p>=count)break;
          const int ri=optionRecipeIndex(p);if(ri<0)continue;
          uiLargeButton(guidedRecipeCard(i),String(recipes[ri].name),
                        ri==chosenRecipe?GREEN:UI_PURPLE,TEAL,true,2);
        }
        uiLargeButton(GUIDED_PAGE,String(recipePage+1)+"/"+String(pages),PANEL,DIM,true,1);
        uiLargeButton(GUIDED_RECIPE_BACK,"BACK",DARK_RED,RED,true,1);
        uiLargeButton(GUIDED_RECIPE_PREV,"PREV",UI_DARK_BLUE,TEAL,recipePage>0,1);
        uiLargeButton(GUIDED_RECIPE_NEXT,"NEXT",UI_DARK_BLUE,TEAL,(recipePage+1)*6<count,1);
      } else {
        ntext(optionField==FIELD_VENUE?"SELECT VENUE":"SELECT TYPE",{8,5,304,23},WHITE,true);
        if(!count)nline("No active recipes",101,TEAL);
        for(int i=0;i<6 && i<count;i++) {
          const int id=guidedOptionId(i);if(id<0)continue;
          uiLargeButton(guidedCategoryCard(i),
            optionField==FIELD_VENUE?String(VENUES[id]):String(TYPES[id]),
            id==selectedGuidedOption()?GREEN:UI_PURPLE,TEAL,true,2);
        }
        uiLargeButton(GUIDED_BACK,"BACK",DARK_RED,RED,true,1);
      }
      break;
    }
    case CREATE_ALARM: {
      uiLargeButton(CREATE_COOK,selectedCook>=0?String(cooks[selectedCook].name):"COOK",UI_DARK_BLUE,TEAL,true,2);
      uiLargeButton(CREATE_RECIPE,selectedRecipe>=0?String(recipes[selectedRecipe].name):"RECIPE",UI_DARK_BLUE,TEAL,true,2);
      uiLargeButton(CREATE_C1,String("c1 ")+homeAlarmTime(createC1Min),UI_PURPLE,TEAL,true,1);
      uiLargeButton(CREATE_C2,String("c2 ")+homeAlarmTime(createC2Min),UI_PURPLE,TEAL,true,1);
      if(createSaveError)ntext("SAVE FAILED - RETRY",{8,176,304,17},RED,true);
      else if(!createTimesValid())ntext("CHECK ALARM ORDER",{8,176,304,17},YELLOW,true);
      else if(!allowNewCoolingPair())ntext("PAST 10:15 PM",{8,176,304,17},YELLOW,true);
      uiLargeButton(CREATE_CANCEL,"CANCEL",DARK_RED,RED,true,1);
      uiLargeButton(CREATE_OK,"CREATE",GREEN,TEAL,
        selectedCook>=0 && selectedRecipe>=0 && allowNewCoolingPair() && createTimesValid(),1);
      break;
    }
    case EDIT_ALARM: {
      ntitle("Edit Alarm");
      // Three identically sized top controls; stage remains read-only.
      uiLargeButton(EDIT_COOK,alarmFirstCookName(draft.initials),PANEL,TEAL,true,1);
      uiLargeButton(EDIT_CLOCK,homeAlarmTime(draft.whenMin),PANEL,TEAL,true,1);
      uiLargeButton(EDIT_STAGE,String("c")+String(draft.stage),PANEL,DIM,true,1);
      // Largest fitting font, minimum 18px, two lines, then ellipsis.
      uiLargeButton(EDIT_RECIPE,String(draft.recipe),PANEL,TEAL,true,2);
      const String fullStatus=draft.status==AlarmStatus::Pending?"PENDING":
                              draft.status==AlarmStatus::Done?"DONE":"CANCELLED";
      uiLargeButton(EDIT_STATUS,String("STATUS: ")+fullStatus,PANEL,TEAL,true,1);
      nbutton(EDIT_DISCARD,"DISCARD",GREY,WHITE);
      nbutton(EDIT_SAVE,"SAVE",GREEN,WHITE);
      break;
    }
    case EDIT_TIME: {
      // Plain text title, no title button or status-header divider.
      ntext("EDIT ALARM TIME",{8,31,304,27},WHITE,true);
      uiLargeButton({14,64,292,46},homeAlarmTime(editTimeCandidate),UI_PURPLE,TEAL,true,1);
      uiLargeButton(editTimeAdjust(0),"-1h",UI_DARK_BLUE,TEAL,true,1);
      uiLargeButton(editTimeAdjust(1),"-5m",UI_DARK_BLUE,TEAL,true,1);
      uiLargeButton(editTimeAdjust(2),"+5m",UI_DARK_BLUE,TEAL,true,1);
      uiLargeButton(editTimeAdjust(3),"+1h",UI_DARK_BLUE,TEAL,true,1);
      uiLargeButton(EDITTIME_CANCEL,"CANCEL",DARK_RED,RED,true,1);
      uiLargeButton(EDITTIME_SAVE,"SAVE",GREEN,TEAL,true,1);
      break;
    }
    case CONFIRMATION: {
      const bool detailsConfirm=(confirmAction==CA_HOME_DONE || confirmAction==CA_LIST_DONE ||
        confirmAction==CA_LIST_CANCEL || confirmAction==CA_LIST_PENDING || confirmAction==CA_SAVE_EDIT);
      const Alarm* a=confirmAction==CA_SAVE_EDIT?&draft:
        (selectedAlarm>=0 && selectedAlarm<alarmCount?&alarms[selectedAlarm]:nullptr);
      if(detailsConfirm && a) {
        homeAutoFit(String("c")+String(a->stage)+" "+homeAlarmTime(a->whenMin)+" "+
                    homeCookName(a->initials),53,49);
        homeAutoFit(String(a->recipe),109,49);
        ntext(confirmationQuestion(),{10,137,300,34},WHITE,false);
      } else {
        ntext(confirmationQuestion(),{10,57,300,41},WHITE,false);
        if(confirmAction==CA_RESTART_DEVICE)
          ntext("Saved alarms remain",{10,122,300,26},WHITE,false);
        else if(confirmAction==CA_CLEAR_ALL_ALARMS)
          ntext("This cannot be undone",{10,122,300,26},YELLOW,false);
        else if(confirmAction==CA_CREATE && selectedCook>=0 && selectedRecipe>=0)
          ntext(String(cooks[selectedCook].initials)+" - "+String(recipes[selectedRecipe].name),
                {10,122,300,33},WHITE,false);
      }
      nbutton(CONFIRM_NO,"NO",DARK_RED,WHITE);
      nbutton(CONFIRM_YES,"YES",GREEN,WHITE);
      break;
    }
    case ALARM_DUE: {
      if(dueAlarm<0||dueAlarm>=alarmCount)break;
      const Alarm &a=alarms[dueAlarm];
      ntile({25,51,270,44},DUE_DARK);
      nline("ALARM DUE",61,WHITE,28);
      nline(String(a.initials)+" "+clockHHMM(a.whenMin)+" c"+String(a.stage),113);
      nline(String(a.recipe),153,TEAL,29);
      nbutton(DUE_DONE,"DONE",GREEN);
      nativeDueEdge=lv_obj_create(nativeRoot);
      lv_obj_set_pos(nativeDueEdge,0,ny(28));
      lv_obj_set_size(nativeDueEdge,PANEL_W,PANEL_H-ny(28));
      lv_obj_set_style_bg_opa(nativeDueEdge,LV_OPA_TRANSP,0);
      lv_obj_set_style_border_color(nativeDueEdge,nativeColor(RED),0);
      lv_obj_set_style_border_width(nativeDueEdge,0,0);
      lv_obj_set_style_radius(nativeDueEdge,0,0);
      lv_obj_set_style_pad_all(nativeDueEdge,0,0);
      lv_obj_clear_flag(nativeDueEdge,LV_OBJ_FLAG_CLICKABLE);
      lv_obj_clear_flag(nativeDueEdge,LV_OBJ_FLAG_SCROLLABLE);
      nativeUpdateDueBorder(alertOn);
      break;
    }
    case COOLING_INFO: {
      ntitle("COOLING GUIDE");
      // Display the approved CoolInfo reference targets; alarm timing unchanged.
      // Source-of-truth Apps Script integration remains a separate data-endpoint task.
      ntile({8,59,304,64},PANEL);ntile({8,130,304,64},PANEL);
      ntext("c1  +2 HOURS",{16,64,288,22},WHITE,false);
      ntext("60\xC2\xB0" "C -> BELOW 21\xC2\xB0" "C",{15,90,290,28},TEAL,true);
      ntext("c2  +6 HOURS TOTAL",{16,135,288,22},WHITE,false);
      ntext("21\xC2\xB0" "C -> BELOW 4\xC2\xB0" "C",{15,161,290,28},TEAL,true);
      nbutton({8,202,304,34},"BACK",BLUE,WHITE);
      break;
    }
    case COOKING_INFO: {
      const int pages=max(1,(COOKING_GUIDE_ITEMS+COOKING_GUIDE_PER_PAGE-1)/COOKING_GUIDE_PER_PAGE);
      cookingGuidePage=constrain(cookingGuidePage,0,pages-1);
      ntitle("COOKING GUIDE",cookingGuidePage,pages);
      for(int slot=0;slot<COOKING_GUIDE_PER_PAGE;slot++) {
        const int j=cookingGuidePage*COOKING_GUIDE_PER_PAGE+slot;
        if(j>=COOKING_GUIDE_ITEMS)break;
        // Cards allow three full 18px lines without truncation.
        const Rect r={8,52+slot*50,304,48};
        ntile(r,PANEL);
        lv_obj_t* guideLabel=ntext(String(COOKING_GUIDE[j].label),
                                   {r.x+6,r.y+1,r.w-54,r.h-2},WHITE,false);
        if(guideLabel)lv_obj_set_style_text_line_space(guideLabel,-3,0);
        ntext(String(COOKING_GUIDE[j].degC)+"\xC2\xB0" "C",
              {r.x+r.w-44,r.y+11,40,23},TEAL,true);
      }
      nbutton(GUIDE_BACK,"BACK",DARK_RED,WHITE);
      nbutton(GUIDE_PREV,"PREV",BLUE,WHITE,cookingGuidePage>0);
      nbutton(GUIDE_NEXT,"NEXT",BLUE,WHITE,(cookingGuidePage+1)*COOKING_GUIDE_PER_PAGE<COOKING_GUIDE_ITEMS);
      break;
    }
    case CALIBRATE_TARGETS: {
      nline("STYLUS CALIBRATION",7,TEAL);
      nline(String("POINT ")+String(calibrationStep+1)+" OF 4",61);
      const int tx=CAL_X[calibrationStep],ty=CAL_Y[calibrationStep];
      ntile({tx-14,ty-2,28,4},YELLOW,0,0);
      ntile({tx-2,ty-14,4,28},YELLOW,0,0);
      nline("Tap the crosshair",119,YELLOW,29);
      nline("Hold SELECT 2s to cancel",174,DIM);
      break;
    }
    case CALIBRATE_VERIFY: {
      ntitle("Verify Calibration");
      nline(calibrationSaveFailed?"SAVE FAILED":calibrationVerified?"ALIGNMENT OK":"TAP THE CROSSHAIR",57,calibrationSaveFailed?RED:calibrationVerified?TEAL:WHITE);
      ntile({145,126,30,4},YELLOW,0,0);
      ntile({158,113,4,30},YELLOW,0,0);
      nline("Test with the stylus",161,TEAL);
      nbutton(VERIFY_RETRY,"RETRY",GREY);
      nbutton(VERIFY_SAVE,"SAVE",GREEN,WHITE,calibrationVerified);
      break;
    }
  }
  nativeRefreshHeader();
  if(lvTouchOverlay)lv_obj_move_foreground(lvTouchOverlay);
  if(!lvInsideHandler)pumpLVGL();
}

// ----------------- ALPHA 1.7D: NONINVASIVE BOOT DIAGNOSTICS --------
// Serial-only observations. No changes to Wi-Fi, NTP, Google Sheets,
// OTA, cached data, alarm timing, or screen navigation.
static void diagBootStage(const char* stage) {
  Serial.printf("[BOOT-STAGE] %s | uptime=%lu ms | freeHeap=%u | minFree=%u | largestInternal=%u | psram=%s\n",
    stage, (unsigned long)millis(), (unsigned)ESP.getFreeHeap(),
    (unsigned)ESP.getMinFreeHeap(),
    (unsigned)heap_caps_get_largest_free_block(MALLOC_CAP_INTERNAL | MALLOC_CAP_8BIT),
    psramFound() ? "YES" : "NO");
  Serial.flush();
}
// ---------------- ALPHA 1.7E: READ-ONLY FS DIAGNOSTICS ------------
// This function NEVER formats, writes, deletes or modifies LittleFS.
// It only reads space usage and file metadata to diagnose boot failures.
static void logFilesystemStatus(const char* stage) {
  Serial.printf("[FS] %s | mounted=%s\n", stage, fsReady ? "YES" : "NO");
  if(!fsReady) {
    Serial.println("[FS] Mount unavailable; no format attempted. NVS is untouched.");
    Serial.flush();
    return;
  }
  size_t total = LittleFS.totalBytes();
  size_t used = LittleFS.usedBytes();
  Serial.printf("[FS] total=%u used=%u free=%u bytes\n",
      (unsigned)total, (unsigned)used,
      (unsigned)(total >= used ? total-used : 0));
  const char* filesToCheck[] = {
    DATA_FILE, DATA_TEMP, DATA_BACKUP, DIAG_ACTIVE_FILE
  };
  for(const char* name : filesToCheck) {
    if(!LittleFS.exists(name)) {
      Serial.printf("[FS] %s: missing\n", name);
      continue;
    }
    fs::File f = LittleFS.open(name, "r");
    if(f) {
      Serial.printf("[FS] %s: %u bytes\n", name, (unsigned)f.size());
      f.close();
    } else {
      Serial.printf("[FS] %s: exists but cannot open\n", name);
    }
  }
  int pendingCount = 0;
  for(int i=0; i<DIAG_PENDING_SLOTS; ++i) {
    String path = diagPendingPath(i);
    if(LittleFS.exists(path.c_str())) pendingCount++;
  }
  Serial.printf("[FS] Pending startup log files=%d/%d\n",
                pendingCount, DIAG_PENDING_SLOTS);
  Serial.flush();
}
// ---------------------- ARDUINO SETUP / LOOP -----------------------
void setup() {
  Serial.begin(115200);
  // Allocate the scrolling log before the first startup message so no
  // Serial output is lost. These buffers no longer occupy static DRAM.
  if(!bootLogInitBuffers())
    Serial.println("[STARTUP LOG] Not enough heap for display mirror; Serial Monitor remains operational");
  delay(150);
  Serial.println("Cooling Alarm v1.31 - Freenove LVGL Alpha 1.8 FS + boot diagnostics");
  Serial.printf("[BOOT-RESET] esp_reset_reason=%d (1=power-on, 3=software, 4=panic, 6=task WDT, 9=brownout)\n",(int)esp_reset_reason());
  diagBootStage("SETUP START");
  bootMs=millis();
