  diagBootStage("BEFORE MEMORY ALLOCATION");
  if(!initAppStorage()) {
    Serial.println("[RAM] Firmware halted safely: not enough RAM to initialize display and alarm records");
    while(true){delay(1000);} // never operate with missing alarm data buffers
  }
  diagBootStage("AFTER MEMORY ALLOCATION");
  prefs.begin("cooltest",false);
  deviceTestMode=prefs.getBool("dev_test",false);
  configuredTimezone=prefs.getString("cfg_tz",TZ_INFO);
  if(configuredTimezone.length()==0)configuredTimezone=TZ_INFO;
  // Production preserves the closed-screen state over reboot. A device
  // already configured for Test wakes with its LCD on, even if closed_mode
  // was left over from a previous Production boot.
  scheduledPreopenBoot=prefs.getBool("preboot",false);
  storeClosedMode=!deviceTestMode && prefs.getBool("closed_mode",false) && !scheduledPreopenBoot;
  pinMode(FREENOVE_BACKLIGHT_PIN,OUTPUT);
  // Change #2: startup console must be readable even if the previous
  // Production session had saved a closed-hours backlight state.
  digitalWrite(FREENOVE_BACKLIGHT_PIN,HIGH);
  initFreenoveLVGL();
  diagBootStage("AFTER LVGL INIT");
  if(ESP.getFreeHeap()<60000) Serial.println("[WARNING] Low LVGL free heap at startup");
  // Keep the vendor's working TFT_eSPI calibration; saved v1.31 touchscreen
  // correction stays in this app's separate Preferences namespace.
  soundInit();
  if(ENABLE_SELECT_BUTTON)pinMode(SELECT_PIN,INPUT_PULLUP);
  if(prefs.getBytesLength("cal")==sizeof(cal))prefs.getBytes("cal",&cal,sizeof(cal));
  if(!calibrationValid(cal)) {
    cal={CAL_MAGIC,CAL_MARGIN,SW-CAL_MARGIN,CAL_MARGIN,SH-CAL_MARGIN,0};
    Serial.println("FREENOVE: initialized neutral app touch calibration");
  }
  homeWiFiSSID=prefs.getString("home_ssid","");
  homeWiFiPassword=prefs.getString("home_pwd","");
  sheetAPIToken=prefs.getString("sheet_key","");
  if(homeWiFiSSID.isEmpty() || homeWiFiPassword.isEmpty())
    Serial.println("WARNING: Home Wi-Fi not configured in NVS");
  if(sheetAPIToken.isEmpty())
    Serial.println("WARNING: Sheets token not configured in NVS");
  // Never reformat LittleFS: preserve the v1.14+ cached roster/recipes.
  // Diagnostic-only: report whether the first mount works on this Freenove.
  diagBootStage("BEFORE LITTLEFS MOUNT");
  fsReady=LittleFS.begin(false);
  diagBootStage("AFTER LITTLEFS MOUNT");
  logFilesystemStatus("AFTER MOUNT, BEFORE LOG CREATION");
  diagBootStage("BEFORE STARTUP LOG BEGIN");
  startupLogBegin();
  diagBootStage("AFTER STARTUP LOG BEGIN");
  logFilesystemStatus("AFTER STARTUP LOG BEGIN");
  startupLogAdd(String("Hardware build: ")+FREENOVE_BUILD_ID+
                " | Freenove FNK0114S 480x320 LVGL");
  if(!fsReady)Serial.println("WARNING: LittleFS unavailable; sheet cache not loaded");
  diagBootStage("BEFORE HARDWARE SELF-TEST");
  startupHardwareSelfTest();
  startupMessage("STARTING DEVICE",FIRMWARE_VERSION,"Checking OTA before local data");
  // Mandatory order: Wi-Fi -> GitHub OTA -> NTP -> cache -> Config -> data flag.
  diagBootStage("BEFORE WIFI");
  const bool connected=connectStartupWiFi();
  diagBootStage(connected ? "WIFI CONNECTED" : "WIFI FAILED");
  if(connected) {
    diagBootStage("BEFORE OTA");
    performGitHubOTAUpdateCheck(); // Successful update reboots immediately.
    diagBootStage("AFTER OTA");
    diagBootStage("BEFORE NTP");
    bool ntpOk=synchronizeClockFromNTP();
    diagBootStage(ntpOk ? "NTP COMPLETE VERIFIED" : "NTP COMPLETE UNVERIFIED");
  }
  // Restore newest independent Config first. The legacy cook/recipe JSON
  // must never overwrite it during offline startup or a data refresh.
  diagBootStage("BEFORE STORED CONFIG");
  loadStoredRuntimeConfig();
  diagBootStage("AFTER STORED CONFIG");
  diagBootStage("BEFORE LOCAL SHEETS CACHE");
  const bool sheetCacheRestored=loadLocalSheetData();
  diagBootStage("AFTER LOCAL SHEETS CACHE");
  logFilesystemStatus("AFTER LOCAL SHEETS CACHE");
  Serial.printf("Sheets cache: %s\n",sheetCacheRestored?"RESTORED":"EMPTY/INVALID");
  startupLogAdd(String("Sheet cache restored: ")+(sheetCacheRestored?"YES":"NO")+
                " | cooks="+String(COOK_COUNT)+" recipes="+String(RECIPE_COUNT));
  diagBootStage("BEFORE LOCAL ALARMS");
  const bool alarmsRestored=loadLocalAlarms();
  diagBootStage("AFTER LOCAL ALARMS");
  startupLogAdd(String("Local alarms restored: ")+(alarmsRestored?"YES":"NO")+
                " | savedAlarms="+String(alarmCount));
  if(connected) {
    diagBootStage("BEFORE PENDING GOOGLE LOG UPLOAD");
    uploadPendingStartupLogs();
    diagBootStage("AFTER PENDING GOOGLE LOG UPLOAD");
    // Always get Config even when UpdateDataNow says No. The existing
    // flag/data/ack workflow remains only for cooks and recipes.
    diagBootStage("BEFORE GOOGLE CONFIG REFRESH");
    refreshConfigAtStartup();
    diagBootStage("AFTER GOOGLE CONFIG REFRESH");
    diagBootStage("BEFORE GOOGLE DATA FLAG");
    checkAndRefreshSheetData();
    diagBootStage("AFTER GOOGLE DATA FLAG");
    logFilesystemStatus("AFTER GOOGLE DATA FLAG");
    // When a newer Config was loaded, roster parsing leaves it untouched.
  }
  if(!alarmsRestored) {
    alarmCount=0;nextId=1;nextPairId=1;
    saveLocalAlarms();
  }
  diagBootStage("BEFORE FINAL GOOGLE LOG UPLOAD");
  startupLogFinalize(connected && WiFi.status()==WL_CONNECTED);
  diagBootStage("AFTER FINAL GOOGLE LOG UPLOAD");
  logFilesystemStatus("AFTER STARTUP LOG FINALIZE");
  startupMessage("SHUTTING DOWN WIFI", "Wi-Fi and Bluetooth", "Saving startup RSSI");
  shutdownStartupRadios();
  diagBootStage("AFTER RADIO SHUTDOWN");
  startupComplete=true;
  // Apply the FINAL mode after the cached + freshly downloaded Config has
  // been read. In Test mode, clear stale Production closed/preboot flags,
  // cancel the heartbeat, and keep the LCD backlight ON at all hours.
  if(deviceTestMode) {
    storeClosedMode=false;
    scheduledPreopenBoot=false;
    prefs.putBool("closed_mode",false);
    prefs.putBool("preboot",false);
    // If switched back to Production during this same closing cycle, it
    // must still execute its close-and-clear exactly once.
    prefs.remove("closed_day");
    stopClosedHeartbeat();
    digitalWrite(FREENOVE_BACKLIGHT_PIN,HIGH);
    Serial.println("TEST MODE: store schedule bypassed; LCD ON; alarms retained");
  } else if(scheduledPreopenBoot)finishPreopeningStartup();
  // Production uses its existing schedule; Test returns immediately.
  storeCheckAtMs=millis();
  // Store schedule may itself open HOME when recovering from closed hours.
  // Release the terminal label BEFORE allowing that screen transition.
  bootLogScreenStop();
  serviceStoreSchedule();
  diagBootStage("AFTER FIRST STORE SCHEDULE CHECK");
  if(storeClosedMode) {
    // In closed mode, don't render or allow UI interaction.
    enterClosedDisplayMode();
    return;
  }
  diagBootStage("ABOUT TO OPEN FIRST UI SCREEN");
  if(!calibrationValid(cal))startCalibration(false);
  else if(ENABLE_SELECT_BUTTON && digitalRead(SELECT_PIN)==LOW) {
    delay(500);
    if(digitalRead(SELECT_PIN)==LOW)startCalibration(false);
    else {int i=nextDue();if(i>=0)enterDue(i);else goHome();}
  } else {int i=nextDue();if(i>=0)enterDue(i);else goHome();}
}

void loop() {
  // Main loop never calls Google Sheets or GitHub; this is a cheap clock
  // comparison once per minute using already cached local time/settings.
  if((uint32_t)(millis()-storeCheckAtMs)>=STORE_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS) {
    storeCheckAtMs=millis();
    serviceStoreSchedule();
  }
  if(storeClosedMode) {
    serviceClosedHeartbeat();
    delay(1); // 10ms LED pulses remain observable without blocking.
    return;   // No touches/alarms/UI when the store is closed.
  }
  // Freenove touch is polled by LVGL; its release event calls onTap()
  // with original 320x240 logical coordinates, preserving hitboxes.
  pumpLVGL();

  // Optional physical SELECT: due acknowledgment; during calibration,
  // holding for 2 seconds safely cancels without saving new values.
  if(ENABLE_SELECT_BUTTON) {
    static bool wasPressed=false,handledHold=false;
    static uint32_t pressedAt=0;
    bool pressed=digitalRead(SELECT_PIN)==LOW;
    if(pressed && !wasPressed) {
      pressedAt=millis();handledHold=false;lastActivity=millis();
      if(screen==ALARM_DUE){ackDue();acknowledgeButton();handledHold=true;}
      else if(screen==CONFIRMATION) {
        // Physical SELECT is exactly the YES confirmation, once per press.
        // Match touchscreen YES: acknowledge BEFORE any restart/action.
        handledHold=true;
        acknowledgeConfirmation();
        yesConfirmation();
      }
    }
    if(pressed && !handledHold &&
       (screen==CALIBRATE_TARGETS || screen==CALIBRATE_VERIFY) &&
       (uint32_t)(millis()-pressedAt)>=2000) {
      handledHold=true;
      exitCalibration(false);
      acknowledgeButton();
    }
    if(!pressed)handledHold=false;
    wasPressed=pressed;
  }
  // 'c' calibrates; 'd' triggers a demo due alarm.
  // Serial override is still supported. For a public OTA release, REMOVE
  // the private bootstrap constants from this one-time USB build.
  // In Serial Monitor select Newline and send:
  // WIFI=yourSSID|yourPassword
  // KEY=optional-private-token-override (not needed in v1.14)
  static String serialCommand;
  while(Serial.available()) {
    char ch=(char)Serial.read();
    if(serialCommand.length()==0 && (ch=='c'||ch=='C')) {
      startCalibration(false);
      continue;
    }
    if(serialCommand.length()==0 && (ch=='d'||ch=='D')) {
      int i=nextPending();if(i>=0)enterDue(i);
      continue;
    }
    if(ch=='\n' || ch=='\r') {
      if(serialCommand.startsWith("WIFI=")) {
        const int sep=serialCommand.indexOf('|',5);
        if(sep>5 && sep<(int)serialCommand.length()-1) {
          const String ssid=serialCommand.substring(5,sep);
          const String pass=serialCommand.substring(sep+1);
          bool ok1=prefs.putString("home_ssid",ssid)>0;
          bool ok2=prefs.putString("home_pwd",pass)>0;
          if(ok1 && ok2) {
            Serial.println("Home Wi-Fi saved in device NVS; restarting...");
            delay(250);
            ESP.restart();
          } else Serial.println("Error: home Wi-Fi credentials NOT saved");
        } else Serial.println("Use WIFI=yourSSID|yourPassword");
      } else if(serialCommand.startsWith("KEY=")) {
        String value=serialCommand.substring(4);value.trim();
        bool safe=value.length()>=12 && value.length()<=96;
        for(size_t i=0;i<value.length();i++) {
          char c=value[i];
          if(!((c>='A'&&c<='Z')||(c>='a'&&c<='z')||
               (c>='0'&&c<='9')||c=='-'||c=='_'))safe=false;
        }
        if(safe && prefs.putString("sheet_key",value)>0) {
          Serial.println("Private Sheets key saved; restarting...");
          delay(250);ESP.restart();
        } else Serial.println("Invalid KEY; use 12-96 letters/numbers/_/-");
      }
      serialCommand="";
    } else if(serialCommand.length()<255) {
      serialCommand+=ch;
    }
  }
  // Cached InActivityInSeconds governs navigation timeout (5s fallback).
  // ALARM DUE never times out; HOME never times out.
  if(screen!=HOME && screen!=ALARM_DUE &&
     screen!=CALIBRATE_TARGETS && screen!=CALIBRATE_VERIFY &&
     (uint32_t)(millis()-lastActivity)>=idleTimeoutMs) {
    goBack();
  }
  if(screen==ALARM_DUE) {
    // Five 60ms chirps with four 30ms gaps, then 2 seconds of silence.
    // alarmChirpIndex identifies the just-started chirp (0..4).
    // During OFF: 30ms between chirps, 2000ms after the fifth chirp.
    // Border, both red LEDs and buzzer follow the same setAlert() signal.
    const uint32_t phaseMs=alertOn ? ALARM_CHIRP_ON_MS :
      (alarmChirpIndex==ALARM_CHIRPS_PER_CYCLE-1 ?
       ALARM_CHIRP_REST_MS : ALARM_CHIRP_OFF_MS);
    if((uint32_t)(millis()-lastBlink)>=phaseMs) {
      lastBlink=millis();
      if(alertOn) setAlert(false);
      else {
        alarmChirpIndex=(uint8_t)((alarmChirpIndex+1)%ALARM_CHIRPS_PER_CYCLE);
        setAlert(true);
      }
    }
  }
  if((uint32_t)(millis()-lastClockDraw)>=1000) {
    lastClockDraw=millis();
    if(screen!=CALIBRATE_TARGETS &&
       !(screen==RECIPE_OPTIONS && optionField==FIELD_RECIPE)) {
      // Update a single native LVGL label, without clearing the screen.
      nativeRefreshHeader();
    }
    // Normal demo clock triggers scheduled alarms in the background.
    // Avoid interrupting a confirmation; C2 remains independently pending.
    if(screen!=ALARM_DUE && screen!=CONFIRMATION &&
       screen!=CALIBRATE_TARGETS && screen!=CALIBRATE_VERIFY) {
      int i=nextDue();
      if(i>=0)enterDue(i);
    }
    // HOME content is stable between actions. The clock digits update
    // without a full-screen repaint, avoiding any periodic flashing.
  }
  pumpLVGL();
  delay(8);
}
